r: 이중 원형 코트 중앙 상자 맞히기 투척 게임
부드러운 공, 단볼 상자(표적), 라인 테이프/분필, 작전판

1) Warm up in pairs by tossing a ball straight up, clapping, and catching.
2) Draw an outer circle (6m diameter) and inner circle (3-4m) with stacked cardboard boxes in the center.
3) Play 3v2 (3 attackers outside the outer circle, 2 defenders between the circles); knock down the top box for 1 point.
4) Progress to using 1 ball per team, passing to open teammates away from defenders before shooting.
Soft balls, cardboard boxes, court chalk/lines, strategy board
디딤발 킥 표적 맞히기 및 3구간 득점 슛 게임
부드러운 축구공, 고깔콘, 끈(골대 상단 표시), 공 바구니
Low-Grade Ball Kicking & 3-Zone Goal Shoot Game

1) Practice dribbling and stopping the ball with soles or hips, then kick at targets 5-8m away.
2) On a 20-30m by 12-15m court, start 4v4 without defenders, shooting from a 5m shoot line and rounding a cone.
3) Advance to 6v6 with 2 defenders blocking shots between the shoot line and goal line and placing stopped balls into side baskets.
4) Award 2 points for kicking under the central rope gate and 1 point for the side gates.
Soft soccer balls, cones, rope/cord, ball baskets
삼각 베이스 훌라후프 아웃존 티볼형 게임
수제 티(T)대, 테니스 라켓, 크고 부드러운 공, 훌라후프(아웃존), 베이스·콘

1) Play 4v4 on a triangle-base court; batters hit a stationary ball off a tee using a hand or tennis racket.
2) Batters run 1st, 2nd, and home (or round 1-, 2-, or 3-point cones along the 1st-base line).
3) Fielders catch the ball, choose the nearest hula-hoop out-zone, and all sit together inside/around it to call 'Out!'
4) Rotate offense and defense after all 4 batters hit; optionally start every turn with bases loaded.
Foam-covered tee, tennis rackets, large soft ball, hula hoops, bases and cones
프리슛존 3대2 수적 우위 및 그리드 코트 간이 농구
농구공, 팀 조끼, 골대, 라인 테이프/콘, 기록지

1) Warm up with Dribble Tag, 45-degree Continuous Shooting, and Pass & Pass support drills.
2) Play 3v2 half-court basketball where offense always has 3 players and defense has 2, with defender-free 'Free Shoot Zones' at 45° angles near the hoop.
3) Advance to 4v3 Grid-Court Basketball by dividing the court diagonally (2 players right, 1 left, 1 free roamer).
4) Reset at the start line whenever the ball goes out or defense gains possession, rotating offense/defense on a timer.
Basketballs, pinnies, basketball hoops, court tape/cones, stat sheets
부드럽고 큰 공(소프트발리볼), 간이 네트(콘·플라스틱 바·고무줄)

1) Use a badminton-sized court (13m×6m) for 3v3 play (rotating if 4+ players per team).
2) Game 1 (Prellball-style, 50-60cm net): let the ball bounce once on your side, slap it down with both hands to pass from player 1 to 2 to 3, then catch and throw over.
3) Game 2 (Soft Volleyball-style, 150-170cm net): serve with a gentle underhand arc; Player 1 catches and passes to Player 2, Player 2 catches and tosses up, and Player 3 hits it over.
4) Allow one-bounce catches if direct catching is too difficult so rallies continue.
Large soft balls, badminton/volleyball net or cones, plastic bars, elastic cord
보물섬 오재미 뺏기 및 3대2 볼 운반 꼬리잡기
허리 태그(수건·머리끈 대용 가능), 오재미(보물), 약간 바람 뺀 한손 크기 공, 고깔콘

1) Warm up with all-vs-all tail tag and Rock-Paper-Scissors breakthrough tag.
2) Treasure Tag (4v4, 18-21m×12-15m): 2 defenders stand in each of 2 tag zones; attackers wear 2 waist tags and must grab 1 beanbag from Treasure Island and return around the outside without losing both tags (2-min halves).
3) Ball-Carry Tag (3v2 then 3v3, 20m×12m): 3 attackers carry balls from start to end zone without losing their waist tag (1 pt per runner).
4) Variation: use 1 ball per team (ball carrier scores 3 pts, decoys score 1 pt).
Waist tags/towels, beanbags, slightly deflated hand-sized balls, cones
중앙 프리존 프리맨 활용 4대4 라인사커 골형 게임
축구공, 고깔콘, 팀 조끼, 라인 테이프

1) Warm up with sole ball taps, dribble-and-stop, knockout dribble tag, and 2v1 grid passing.
2) Play 4v4 (two 3-minute halves) on a 30m×18m court with a 4m×4m central 'Free Zone' holding 1 unguarded Freeman per team.
3) Pass into the Freeman and spread wide left or right so no defender blocks the passing lane before receiving and shooting.
4) Score 2 points through the center cone gate and 1 point through the outer gates (below cone height).
Soccer balls, cones, team bibs, court lines
강 건너기·고무줄 높이뛰기·켄파 후프 리듬 릴레이
긴 줄, 고무줄 및 높이 조절 지주, 훌라후프(또는 링), 링 배턴
River Jump, Elastic High-Jump & Hop-Scotch Hoop Relay

1) Warm up with 'Say the Same, Do the Opposite' directional jumping.
2) River Jumping: lay two ropes to form straight, wide, or winding rivers designed by each group, leaping across with one or two feet.
3) Elastic Jumping: jump over elastic cords set at progressive heights (Frog, Rabbit, Kangaroo levels) using a rhythmic run-up.
4) Hoop Hop Relay: carry a ring baton through custom hoop patterns; adjust hoop counts by team rank so every team can win.
Ropes, elastic cords with stands, hula hoops/rings, ring batons
구불구불 로프 코스 및 단볼 장애물 간격 설계 릴레이
긴 로프, 링 배턴, 낮은 단볼 상자, 고깔콘
Winding Rope Course & Custom-Spaced Cardboard Hurdle Relay

1) Lay long ropes in zigzag or winding shapes on the ground; run along the rope and tag the next runner's right palm.
2) Progress to passing a ring baton after rounding the back of the team line.
3) Set up low cardboard boxes as hurdles for an obstacle relay.
4) Let teams experiment with box height and spacing to discover the layout that lets them run without losing speed.
Long ropes, ring batons, low cardboard boxes, cones
터치 대시·마커 술래·합산 20 계산 릴레이 5종 웜업
Touch-Dash, Marker Defense & Sum-to-20 Math Relay 5-Pack

1) Touch Dash (1v1): front runner holds hands behind back; back runner fakes with one hand and taps with BOTH hands to trigger a sprint race.
2) Feint Tag (1v1): whenever the leader steps on a side marker, the tagger must also step on it before blocking the gate.
3) Marker Tag (3v1): 3 defenders guard 4 floor markers by standing on them so the walking tagger cannot step on an empty marker.
4) Math Relay & RPS Sprint: relay to collect numbered bibs totaling 20+ (or exactly 20), and play Rock-Paper-Scissors where winners/losers race to opposite color markers.
트라이 경쟁·고양이와 쥐·삼각 태그술래 등 태그럭비 도입 5선
럭비공(또는 공), 허리 태그(수건·조끼 대용 가능), 고깔콘
Tag Rugby Lead-Up 5-Pack: Try Race, Cat & Mouse & Triangle Tag

1) Try Race (1v1): coach tosses a rugby ball for an irregular bounce; first to grab it tries to score while the other pulls their waist tag.
2) Cat & Mouse (1v1): called player grabs the ball and sprints to their back line while the partner chases their tag (start standing, sitting, or prone).
3) RPS Try & Gate Pass (1v1): RPS loser touches a coach/cone before defending; in Gate Pass, defender must touch whichever side cone the leader touches.
4) Triangle Tag (3 players): 1 tagger chases 2 ball-carriers around a cone triangle.
Rugby balls, waist tags (or towels/bibs), cones
운 시험·6대1·룰렛·기차 꼬리잡기 등 소집단 태그럭비 5선
럭비공, 허리 태그(수건·조끼), 고깔콘, 빈 페트병
Small-Group Tag Rugby 5-Pack: 6v1 Crossover, Roulette & Train Tag

1) Luck Tag: pass balls left (1 clap) or right (2 claps) in a circle; on the whistle, ball holders evade taggers for 5 seconds.
2) 6v1 Cone-Safe Tag: only the ball carrier can be tagged; players without the ball stand safely touching a cone and use hand-to-hand crossovers.
3) All-Out Tag & Roulette Tag: 10-second free-for-all tag, or spin a bottle (1 tagger) / rugby ball (2 taggers) in the center to pick taggers instantly.
4) Train Tag (1v3): 3 connected players maneuver together to protect the back player's tag from 1 chaser.
Rugby balls, waist tags, cones, empty plastic bottle
빙고·4색 콘 정렬·손잡기·조끼 겹쳐 입기 이색 릴레이 5선
4색 고깔콘, 훌라후프(또는 마커), 다수의 팀 조끼(비브스)
5 Brain & Teamwork Relays: Bingo, 4-Color Sort, Chain & Bib-Layer Relay

1) Bingo Relay: 3 cones per team on a 3×3 grid; shift your own cones after placing all 3 to make 3-in-a-row.
2) Color-Sort Relay: 16 mixed cones (4 colors × 4); each runner swaps just 2 cones per turn until all 4 columns match by color.
3) Hand-Hold Chain Relay: runner 1 completes a lap, grabs runner 2's hand, then runner 3, running together as a growing chain.
4) Obstacle & Bib-Layering Relay: zigzag/two-foot jump relay, and a relay where runners put on one extra bib each lap and pass the entire stack to the next teammate.
점프 가위바위보 및 손잡고 원형 회전 눈가림 술래잡기

1) Jump RPS Warmup: jump while spinning arms overhead, play Rock-Paper-Scissors with partners, and perform 5 high jumps if you lose.
2) Linked-Circle Blindfold Tag: 6-8 runners hold hands in a circle around 1 blindfolded tagger in the center.
3) Runners must evade the blindfolded tagger's touch by shifting and rotating the entire circle without ever letting go of hands.
4) If tagged, become the new tagger; if two runners accidentally break hands, those two play RPS and the loser becomes the tagger.
長野県教育委員会スポーツ課
사과 매달리기 거리 왕복 및 비닐봉지 썰매 견인 릴레이
Chin-Hang Distance Dash, 3-Way Tug & Plastic-Bag Sled Relay

1) Apple-Hang Dash (pairs): while Partner A holds a flexed-arm hang on the low bar, Partner B sprints to touch distance-scored lines and returns before A drops.
2) 1v1 Hand Pull & 3-Way Rope Tug: pull a looped rope among 3 players to be the first to touch your outer floor marker.
3) Plastic-Bag Sled Pull (pairs): one partner puts both feet inside a plastic bag, squats, and holds a rope while the other pulls them through a cone slalom course.
4) Finish with a team sled-pull slalom relay.
Horizontal bar, short ropes, plastic shopping bags, cones
福岡市教育委員会 動画配信チャンネル（小１）
제자리 어깨터치·태그뺏기 및 신문지 칼 닌자 회피 게임
허리 태그(손수건), 둥글게 만 신문지 막대, 초시계
Stationary Shoulder-Tap, Tag-Pull & Newspaper-Sword Ninja Dodge

1) Stationary Shoulder Tap (pairs): stand facing a partner without moving your feet; twist, lean, and arch your torso to tap their shoulders as many times as possible in 30 seconds.
2) Stationary Tag Pull (pairs): without moving your feet, pull your partner's waist tag/towel while twisting to protect your own.
3) Ninja Training Game (pairs): one partner swings a rolled-up newspaper sword while the other dodges left, right, ducks, or jumps for 30 seconds.
4) Apply these body-dodging skills to outdoor directional tag.
Waist tags or hand towels, rolled newspaper sticks, timer
大分県教育庁チャンネル
러시아워 경보 술래잡기 및 2·3인 협동 슈와치 얼음땡
고깔콘(구역 표시), 홍백 모자(또는 팀 조끼)
Rush-Hour Fast-Walk Tag & 2-3 Player 'Shwatch!' Rescue Freeze Tag

1) Rush Hour Tag (pairs or quads): inside a compact cone zone, players may ONLY fast-walk (no running), including linked-arm walking; if tagged, do 5 jumps and switch taggers.
2) Shwatch Freeze Tag: tagged players freeze in place and call 'Help!'
3) To unfreeze a classmate, TWO (and later THREE) teammates must arrive together, duck under the frozen player's arms, and pop up shouting 'Shwatch!'
4) Variation: 3 rescuers join hands to form a complete circle around the frozen player to unfreeze them.
파이어 앤 아이스 캐치 구출 술래잡기 (3단계 레벨업)
Fire and Ice Throwing & Catching Tag (Levels 1–3)

1) 3 Icicle taggers hold blue foam noodles and 3 Fireball rescuers hold red foam balls.
2) Players get frozen in 3 ways: tagged by an icicle, stepping out of bounds, or falling down; frozen players pump one fist high in the air while stepping side-to-side in place.
3) To unfreeze, a Fireball holder tosses the ball and the frozen player must catch it cleanly in the air, becoming the new Fireball holder.
4) Level 1: dropped fireballs can be re-tossed and fire holders are invincible. Level 2: dropped fireballs die on the floor. Level 3: icicles can freeze Fireball holders too!
스위치(Switch) 사각형 코너 자리바꾸기 무교구 순발력 게임

1) Set up a 15-foot square (or 4 cones) for groups of 6-7 players: 4 on the corners, 1 in the middle, and 1 caller waiting 2 steps outside in line.
2) When the caller shouts 'Switch!', all 5 active players must sprint to claim a different corner.
3) The odd player out (or anyone who falls off their feet) goes to the back of the waiting line, and the caller steps into the middle.
4) Resolve ties by whose foot touched the corner first, or quick Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Four-square court lines, floor tape, or 4 cones per group
몬스터볼(대형 짐볼) 사각형 밖으로 던져 밀어내기 게임
대형 짐볼 또는 킨볼 1개, 다수의 소프트 폼볼(게이터스킨 볼)
Monster Ball (Abominable Snowball Fight) Overhand Throw Game

1) Place a large exercise ball or Kin-Ball ('Monster Ball') in the center of a large floor square, with 2 or 4 teams behind the outer lines.
2) On the whistle, throw small foam balls overhand to hit the Monster Ball and roll it across the opposing team's boundary line for 1 point.
3) Players may enter the square anywhere to retrieve small balls, but MUST step completely outside the square before throwing.
4) Stepping inside the square while throwing results in sitting in the penalty box for the round; touching or blocking the Monster Ball with your body awards 1 automatic point to the other team.
1 large exercise ball or Kin-Ball, 20–30 small foam balls
표적 득점형 훌라헛(후프 성) 건설·공방 캐슬볼
컬러 훌라후프 다수, 소프트 피구공, 농구골대 및 볼카트(상자), 스쿠터 보드, 고깔콘
Castleball / Hula Hut Breakdown with 5 Team Roles

1) Everyone starts as a Scorer throwing balls into targets (ball cart/box = 2 hoops, side basketball hoop = 4 hoops, far hoop = 6 hoops; no guarding targets).
2) Builders collect earned hoops and construct a Hula Hut on their side whenever they have 6 hoops (1 base, 2 inner leaning, 2 outer leaning, 1 roof).
3) Protectors guard their team's Hula Huts using their bodies while Destroyers throw balls to knock down opposing Hula Huts.
4) Gatherers ride scooters onto the other side to retrieve balls; the team with the most standing Hula Huts at the end wins.
Hula hoops (6 per hut), foam dodgeballs, basketball hoops, ball carts/boxes, scooters, tall cones
마피아 볼(Mafia Ball) 소집단 패스 협동 서바이벌 피구
Mafia Ball Multi-Team Passing & One-Revive Dodgeball

1) Divide the class into small teams of 3–4 players scattered freely across the gym with 4 foam balls.
2) Players CANNOT run while holding a ball—they must pass to teammates to set up throws.
3) When hit, players go to the sideline; each player gets ONE chance per round to re-enter the game.
4) If a surviving teammate makes a direct air catch (no floor or wall bounce), the teammate waiting longest returns; a second hit eliminates the player for the round until one team remains.
공 종류별 이동 미션 둥지 털기(Rob the Nest) 및 앵그리버드 수비
Rob the Nest with Equipment-Specific Locomotor Challenges & Angry Birds

1) Place 4 colored hoops (nests) in the corners and 10+ mixed balls/beanbags (eggs) in the center.
2) One runner per team collects 1 egg at a time from the middle; once the middle is empty, the teacher calls 'Rob the Nest!' and runners steal 1 egg at a time from other nests (no guarding nests).
3) Progression: each egg type requires a specific movement (soccer ball = foot dribble, basketball = hand dribble, beanbag = balance on head, bouncy ball = jump with ball between knees).
4) Add 1–2 'Angry Bird' taggers who force tagged runners to return the stolen egg.
5 hula hoops, soccer balls, basketballs, beanbags, bouncy balls
라비넨발(Lawinenball) 눈사태 증식 테니스공·조끼 터치 술래잡기
테니스공 또는 소프트볼 다수, 팀 조끼(비브스)

1) Start with 1 tagger holding a tennis ball, softball, or pinnie in hand while extra balls/pinnies are placed along the sideline.
2) The tagger runs and touches fleeing players directly with the ball/pinnie in hand (no throwing).
3) Anyone tagged grabs a tennis ball or puts on a pinnie and joins the taggers, growing like an avalanche until only 1 runner remains.
4) If holding a small ball is hard to spot, have taggers wear pinnies and tag by hand.
배고픈 하마들(Hungry Hungry Hippos) 중앙 볼 수거 스쿠터·하키 릴레이
테니스공 또는 콩주머니 다수, 팀별 양동이(바구니), 고깔콘, (선택) 스쿠터·하키스틱·글러브
Hungry Hungry Hippos Center-Circle Ball Collection Relay

1) Place a large pile of tennis balls or beanbags inside the center circle, and set up 4+ teams at corner cones with a bucket per team.
2) Basic Relay: one player per team sprints to the center, grabs 1 ball, places it in their team bucket, and tags the next runner.
3) Scooter Variation: players propel themselves on a scooter board to collect each ball.
4) Skill Variations: older grades use a hockey stick to dribble a ball back or wear a baseball glove to pick it up; count balls when the center is empty.
Tennis balls or beanbags, buckets, cones, optional scooters/hockey sticks/gloves
APT 리듬 비트 따라하기 댄스 피트니스 브레인 브레이크
PhysEdZone 'APT' Follow-Along Dance Fitness Brain Break

1) Stand in personal space with arm's-length clearance facing the screen in the gym or classroom.
2) Follow the on-screen rhythm cues set to the 'APT' beat, including alternating hand-stacking motions, step-touches, jumps, and heart poses.
3) Increase intensity during the chorus with continuous knee bounces and overhead arm reaches.
4) Complete the full 3-minute song nonstop as an energizing warm-up or brain break.
골드러시(Gold Rush) 금괴 6개 탈환 및 감옥 구출 진지전
Gold Rush Capture-the-Gold & Jailbreak Strategy Game

1) Divide the gym in half; each team has a back base holding 3 gold pieces (pins/beanbags) and a corner mat jail.
2) Cross into enemy territory to reach their safe base; from there, choose EITHER to carry 1 gold piece back OR high-five a jailed teammate for a free walk back (hands raised).
3) If tagged while carrying gold, return the gold and go to jail; settle any borderline line-tags instantly with Rock-Paper-Scissors.
4) Limit each team to 1 jail guard inside a coned buffer zone; first team to collect all 6 gold pieces wins.
6 bowling pins or beanbags, 2 gym mats, cones
쓰리 볼(Three Ball) 외곽 터치 부활 및 농구 슛 전원 탈옥 피구
소프트 피구공 3개, 농구 코트 및 농구 골대
Three Ball Dodgeball with Sideline Tag-In & Basketball Jailbreak

1) Place 2 dodgeballs on the free-throw lines and 1 on the center line of a basketball court; players inside CANNOT walk with a ball (pivoting only).
2) Players are out if hit by a ball, caught throwing, stepping on/over the boundary line, or walking with a ball, and must exit the court.
3) Out players can re-enter and swap places by (a) grabbing a loose ball outside (5-sec limit, walking allowed outside) and hitting/catching an active player, or (b) tagging an active player standing too close to the boundary line.
4) Jailbreak Bonus: if an out player shoots a basket from outside the court, ALL out players return to the game!
3 foam dodgeballs, basketball court and hoops
마우스트랩(Mousetrap) 음악 정지 인간 쥐덫 원형 술래잡기
Mousetrap! Musical Circle Barrier Warm-Up Game

1) Half the class joins hands in a circle with arms raised high to form the 'mousetrap', while the other half are 'mice'.
2) While music plays, the mice run in and out of the circle underneath the raised arms.
3) When the music stops, the circle players immediately drop down into a squat position to close the trap.
4) Any mice trapped inside the circle join the circle hands, making the trap larger each round until all mice are caught; then switch roles.
Music player or whistle (no equipment needed)
블래스터볼(Blasterball) 무정지 홈런 질주 대 수비 5패스 야구
실내용 배트(폼배트), 실내 소프트볼, 베이스용 매트 4장, (선택) 티대
Blasterball Non-Stop Base Running vs. 5-Pass Fielding Game

1) Set up 4 gym mats as bases; divide into a batting team lined up safely along the wall and a scattered fielding team.
2) The batter hits a pitched or tee-placed indoor ball and must run around ALL 4 bases nonstop without stopping at any base.
3) Meanwhile, the fielding team retrieves the ball and must complete 5 clean passes to different teammates while counting aloud (dropped passes don't count, just continue).
4) If the batter reaches home before 5 passes are completed, they score 1 point; otherwise they are out. Bat through the entire lineup before switching.
4 gym mats (or indoor bases), indoor foam bat, soft indoor ball, optional batting tee
외계인 대 우주비행사(Aliens vs Astronauts) 행성 핀 사수 오버핸드 던지기
볼링핀 또는 고깔콘 다수(행성), 소프트 피구공 다수(미사일)
Aliens vs. Astronauts Planet-Pin Overhand Throwing Game

1) Set up bowling pins or cones ('planets') across one side of the gym and divide K–2 students into Aliens (throwers) and Astronauts (defenders).
2) On the whistle/music, Aliens grab foam dodgeballs ('missiles') and use overhand throws to knock down the planets.
3) Astronauts defend the planets by blocking incoming missiles, throwing/rolling balls back to the Aliens' side, and standing knocked-down planets back up.
4) Play continuously for 2–3 minutes, then switch roles so everyone plays both sides.
Bowling pins or cones, foam dodgeballs
코너 볼(Corner Ball) 4모서리 벤치 골대 번호 호명 축구

1) Place 4 benches (flipped on their sides as goals) across the 4 corners of the gym; divide into 4 teams crouching behind their bench and number players 1–5.
2) Place a soccer ball in the center and call out a number (e.g., 'Number 4!'); all four #4 players jump into the court for a 1v1v1v1 battle.
3) Score 1 point by kicking the ball against any of the other 3 teams' benches; the other 3 teams perform quick jumping jacks before resetting.
4) Call two numbers at once for 2v2v2v2 cooperative play.
Soccer ball, 4 gym benches (or 8 cones for corner goals)

3) Choose task-specific stations: (a) a cloth ribbon tied at bar center for takeoff accuracy, (b) an X-shaped elastic cord to cue high leg clearance, (c) double parallel bars for wide mid-air 'figure-4' scissors action, or (d) 7-step speed approaches.
4) Hold a final team meet where points are awarded based on each student's improvement over their personal target height.
High-jump standards, crossbars/bamboo poles, elastic cords, landing mats, takeoff boards, spot markers
고학년 매트 운동: 관성 챌린지·베이직 타임(3종목×4분) 및 연속 기술 완성
체조 매트 다수(단차·경사 구성용), 모둠 학습 카드
Upper-Grade Mat Gymnastics: Basic-Time Stations & Seamless Routine Building

1) Start every lesson with the 'Familiarization Challenge' combining lower- and middle-grade rolls and balances.
2) Basic Time (three 4-minute rotations): practice individual skills—such as handstand forward roll, straddle forward/backward roll, and cartwheel—using stacked mats to cushion impact and aid rotation.
3) Challenge Time (Routine Combination): link 3–4 mastered skills smoothly without extra steps, focusing on a clean final standing finish.
4) If one skill breaks down during the routine, rotate back to the single-skill station for a quick fix before re-attempting the full sequence.
중학년 높이뛰기: 3·5보 '1-2-1-2-팡!' 구름판 점프 및 개인 기록 향상 대항전
높이뛰기 지주·고무줄/바, 구름판, 착지 안전 매트, 소형 허들, 기록 카드
Middle-Grade High Jump: '1-2-1-2-Bang!' 5-Step Takeoff & Team Improvement Contest

1) Warm up with 3-step rhythm jumps over elastic cords and mini-hurdles, practicing soft knee-bent landings on a safety mat.
2) Progress from a 3-step approach to a 5-step takeoff-board jump while teammates chant '1, 2, 1, 2, Bang!' in rhythm.
3) Focus on stamping the takeoff foot strongly while driving the opposite lead knee high and landing on the lead foot first.
4) Final Team Contest: compare each student's 5-step height against their baseline 3-step height from Lesson 1, summing everyone's improvement points for the team score.
High-jump standards, elastic cords/bars, takeoff boards, safety mats, mini-hurdles, scorecards
서클 레이싱(Circle Racing) 콘 회전 방향전환 2색 빈백 낚아채기

1) In groups of 4 around a single center cone, place 4 different colored beanbags (e.g., red, blue, yellow, green) just outside the cone.
2) On the first whistle, all 4 players circle slowly around the cone in one direction.
3) Every time the whistle blows again, players must immediately reverse their circling direction.
4) When the teacher calls out TWO colors (e.g., 'Green and Yellow!'), the first two players to grab those two beanbags win the round!
1 cone and 4 different colored beanbags per group of 4, whistle
훌라후프 매드니스(Hulahoop Madness) 음악 정지 무탈락 후프 섬 공유하기
Hula-Hoop Madness Zero-Elimination Musical Hoop Sharing

1) Scatter 10–20 hula hoops across the gym floor and briefly discuss personal space and how many classmates might fit inside a single hoop.
2) While music plays, students run or skip freely around the gym without stepping inside any hoops.
3) When the music stops, everyone jumps into the nearest hula hoop—multiple students can share the same hoop with zero elimination.
4) Remove several hoops after each round so students must cooperate and squeeze more classmates into the remaining hoops!
롤러 볼(Roller Ball) 학급 반반 원형 포위 발 맞히기 굴리기 피구
Roller Ball Half-and-Half Circle Foot-Target Rolling Dodgeball

1) Place half the class around a large circle with soft foam volleyballs as 'Rollers', and put the other half inside the circle as dodgers.
2) Rollers roll their balls across the floor trying to hit the feet of players inside the circle.
3) Whenever an inside player's foot is hit, they leave the middle and join the outer circle as an additional Roller.
4) Continue until only 1 survivor remains in the middle, then swap the starting halves for Round 2.
컬러 훌라후프 태그(Color Hula Hoop Tag) 스틱 색깔별 후프 미션·10점 차감 술래
Color Hula-Hoop Tag with Color-Matched Noodles & 10-Point Countdown

1) Spread out 2 hula hoops of each color across the gym floor and give taggers short foam noodles matching those exact colors.
2) Exercise Mode: when tagged by a colored noodle, run to a matching colored hula hoop and complete a jump/exercise inside it to re-enter.
3) 10-Point Countdown Mode: everyone starts with 10 points; each time you are tagged, tap your foot inside the matching colored hoop to deduct 1 point and keep running.
4) Course-Change Rule: if you are heading toward a red hoop after a red tag and get tagged by a blue noodle along the way, immediately change course and head to a blue hoop instead!
Colored hula hoops (2 per color), matching colored short pool noodles
모스키토 태그(Mosquito Tag) 모기 침 스틱 술래와 약(훌라후프) 구출
모기 침 폼누들(가운데 절개 후 테이프 보강) 2~3개, 구출용 훌라후프 2~3개
Mosquito Tag with Pool-Noodle Proboscis & Hula-Hoop Medicine Rescue

1) Cut a slit near one end of a pool noodle and tape both ends of the slit so it fits snugly on top of a tagger's head like a mosquito proboscis.
2) Mosquito taggers chase players around the gym; anyone tagged gets 'itchy' and must freeze in place scratching both shoulders.
3) Rescuers carrying a hula hoop ('medicine') cure itchy classmates by placing the hoop over their head and dropping it to the floor.
4) Anyone currently holding a medicine hula hoop cannot be tagged by mosquitoes!
파울링(Fowling) 미식축구 볼링 5핀 격파 오버핸드 투척 릴레이
팀별 훌라후프 1개, 미식축구공(또는 폼볼) 1개, 볼링핀 5개(팀당), 바닥 표시 점
Fowling (Football Bowling) 5-Pin Knockdown Overhand Throw Relay

1) Set 1 hula hoop at the throwing line and 5 bowling pins at the far end for each team.
2) The first thrower steps into the hoop, grips the football laces (side to target, step with opposite foot), and throws once to knock down their team's pins (knocking down a neighbor's pin helps that neighbor!).
3) The thrower runs to retrieve the football and MUST hand it directly to the next teammate in line (throwing the ball back is forbidden).
4) Any pin accidentally bumped by a runner's body must be stood back up; first team to knock down all 5 pins wins.
1 hula hoop, 1 foam football, and 5 bowling pins per team
주키퍼스(Zookeepers) 동물원 우리 탈출 동물 흉내 술래잡기

1) Place 4 gym mats in the corners as 'animal cages' with students on the mats and 2–3 Zookeepers in the center.
2) Tell a quick story: 'The zookeepers were just finishing work for the day when suddenly all the MONKEYS escaped!'
3) All students leave the cages moving and acting like that animal while the Zookeepers try to tag them.
4) Tagged animals return to their corner mat cages until everyone is caught; start the next round by calling a new animal (kangaroos, crabs, frogs, horses) to practice varied locomotor skills.
팀 핀 배틀(Team Pin Battle) 핀 쓰러지면 운동 후 상대 진영 침투 투척전
2색 볼링핀(학생 1인당 1개), 바닥 원마커(핀 위치 표시용), 소프트 폼볼 다수
Team Pin Battle with Cross-Court Respawn & 360° Pin Defense

1) Divide the gym in half for two teams (Red vs. Green); every student places 1 bowling pin of their team color on a floor spot and guards it.
2) Grab foam balls, return to your pin, and throw to knock down pins of the OPPOSITE color while blocking balls aimed at your pin.
3) Whenever your pin is knocked down, pick up your pin, go to the back exercise zone, and complete 10 reps (push-ups, shoulder taps, or jumping jacks).
4) Cross-Court Respawn Twist: after finishing your 10 reps, re-enter on the OPPOSITE side of the gym, set your pin on an open spot, and keep throwing at the opposing team's pin color!
2 colors of bowling pins (1 per student), poly spots, foam balls
스틸 더 볼(Steal The Ball) 종목별 드리블·셀프토스·패스 2인 둥지 릴레이
팀별 훌라후프 6~8개, 단원별 공(축구공·농구공·배구공·폼볼 등) 다수
Steal The Ball Skill-Specific Relay (Soccer, Basketball, Volleyball & Throw-Catch)

1) Form 6–8 small teams of 2–3 players each stationed at perimeter hula hoops with a large supply of balls in the center.
2) Players alternate retrieving 1 ball at a time from the center, and once the center is empty, stealing 1 ball at a time from other teams' hoops (no defending allowed).
3) Apply sport-specific skill rules to every trip: (a) Soccer: foot-dribble back and trap inside the hoop; (b) Basketball: hand-dribble back.
4) (c) Volleyball: continuously self-set overhead all the way back to your hoop; (d) Football/Baseball: run to grab a ball and throw it from there to your partner standing inside your home hoop for a clean catch!
6–8 hula hoops, sport-specific balls (soccer, basketball, volleyball, or foam balls)
캡처 더 플래그 릴레이(Capture The Flag Relay) 3단계 거리 후프 패스·캐치 깃발 탈환
팀별 출발 콘 1개, 거리별 훌라후프 3개, 폼볼(또는 미식축구공) 1개, 끝선 깃발/콩주머니(팀당 15개)
Capture The Flag Relay: 3-Distance Hoop Throw-and-Catch Progression

1) Line up each team behind a start cone with 3 hula hoops placed in a straight line ahead at short (yellow), medium (red), and long (blue) distances, and a pile of flags/beanbags at the far end.
2) One teammate stands inside the 1st hoop; the first thrower in line throws the ball to the hoop player. On a clean catch, the catcher sprints to the far end, grabs 1 flag, and brings it to the team cone.
3) Rotation: the thrower moves into the hoop, and the catcher joins the back of the line (if the pass is dropped, the thrower retrieves the ball for the next person in line while the hoop player stays until they make a catch).
4) Collect 5 flags from Hoop 1, then advance to Hoop 2 for 5 flags, and Hoop 3 for 5 flags—first team to capture 15 flags wins!
Start cones, 3 hula hoops per team, 1 ball per team, 15 flags or beanbags per team
스쿠터 보드 다방향(전진·후진·측면·빈백 균형) 왕복 릴레이
팀별 스쿠터 보드 1개, 출발·반환점 고깔콘, 콩주머니(머리 균형용)

1) Divide the class into even teams behind starting cones, with 1 scooter board per team and a turnaround pylon at the far end.
2) Seated on the scooter, the first player propels themselves down, rounds the far pylon, and returns to hand off the scooter to the next teammate.
3) Competitive Mode: players sit down at the back of their line after finishing their lap; first team all seated wins.
4) Non-Competitive Skill Mode: run continuous laps while changing the movement challenge every few minutes (forwards, backwards, sideways, or balancing a beanbag on your head).
Scooter boards (1 per team), cones/pylons, beanbags
빈백 배틀(Bean Bag Battle) 7후프 줄다리기형 바구니 투구 대결
훌라후프 7개, 대형 고깔콘 1개, 출발 콘 2개, 바구니 2개, 콩주머니 2개
Bean Bag Battle: 7-Hoop Tug-of-War Basket Toss Relay

1) Two teams of 3–5 players line up behind starting cones facing their own laundry basket/crate target, with 1 beanbag per team.
2) Between the two teams, lay a line of 7 hula hoops with a large cone standing in the center (4th) hoop as a tug-of-war score marker.
3) On 'Go!', the first player in each line tosses their beanbag toward their basket, sprints to retrieve it, hands it to the next player, and rotates to the back.
4) Every time a player makes a basket, they move the center cone 1 hoop closer to the opponent's end; first team to push the cone all the way off the opponent's end wins!
7 hula hoops, 1 large cone, 2 start cones, 2 baskets/crates, 2 beanbags
4인 동시 회전 추격 스프린트(Mass Chase Sprint) 순발력 달리기

1) Split the class into two lines on opposite sidelines; place 1 cone about one-third of the way ahead of each line in a counterclockwise loop.
2) One runner from each line steps out to start at their ahead cone (the 'rabbit'), while the next player in each line readies to chase.
3) On the whistle, all 4 runners (2 chasers and 2 rabbits) sprint at maximum speed counterclockwise toward the opposite line.
4) Runners join the back of the opposite line while the next player steps up to the cone; even if caught, nobody is eliminated!
포 코너스(4 Corners) 눈감고 점핑잭 10회 카운트 4모서리 선택 게임
도구 없음(모서리 번호 표지판 선택 가능)

1) Number the four corners of the gym or classroom 1, 2, 3, and 4, and choose 1 'It' player to stand in the center.
2) The center player closes their eyes and counts to 10 while performing 10 jumping jacks; meanwhile, everyone else skips or gallops to choose one of the 4 corners.
3) At 10, keeping their eyes closed, the center player calls out a corner number (1–4).
4) Everyone in that called corner comes to the middle to join the center player in doing jumping jacks for the next countdown until 1 winner remains!
실리 바나나스(Silly Bananas) 원숭이 술래와 15초 외발 균형 부활 태그
도구 없음(술래 구별용 조끼 선택 가능)

1) Spread out across the playing area and choose 2 'Monkeys' as taggers.
2) Round 1 (Peel the Banana): if tipped by a monkey, freeze with both hands overhead like a banana until a classmate peels one arm down and then the other; players not frozen at the whistle earn 1 point.
3) Round 2 (15-Second Flamingo Balance): when tipped by a monkey, balance on one leg for 15 seconds without letting your raised foot touch the ground.
4) Once you complete the 15-second balance, you are free to run again!
팩맨 라인 바리케이드·섀도 태그·서바이버 등 무교구 체육 게임 7선
7 Zero-Equipment PE Games: Pac-Man Roadblock, Shadow Tag & Survivor

1) Pac-Man Line Tag: everyone moves strictly along gym floor lines; if tagged by a Pac-Man, sit down on the line as a roadblock that runners cannot pass (add a Doctor who heals roadblocks!).
2) Shadow Tag & Leg Tag (pairs): chase your partner until the freeze whistle—if within arm's reach, the runner does 5 star jumps, otherwise the shadow does; in Leg Tag, tap behind your partner's knees to trigger a quick push-up.
3) Knock & Run and Conditional Bull Rush: creep up behind a partner, tap their shoulder, and race back to start; or run across the field when the Bull Rush tagger calls a trait matching you.
4) Revenge Survivor Tag & Number Wall Relay: everyone is 'It'—sit when tagged and re-enter as soon as your tagger gets tagged; finish with multi-number wall sprint relays.
초등 배구 1인 기초 기능 12단계 마스터 챌린지 (디그·세트·스파이크)
12 Progressive Solo Volleyball Skill Challenges (Dig, Set & Wall Spike)

1) Dig Challenges (1–5): (1) Bounce-Dig-Bounce with straight forearms and leg push, (2) Throw-Clap Behind Back-Dig-Catch, (3) Throw-360° Spin-Dig-Catch, (4) Alternating Right/Left Single-Arm Touches, and (5) Continuous Wall Digging (allow 1 bounce if needed).
2) Set Challenges (6–11): (6) Bounce High-Set High-Catch, (7) Throw-Multi Clap-Set-Catch, (8) Throw-360° Spin-Set-Catch, (9) Continuous Overhead Setting while slowly turning 360°, (10) Two-Foot Jump Catch at peak reach & Jump-Set, and (11) Wall Setting & Seated Floor Setting.
3) Spike Challenge (12): stand 3–4m from a wall, toss the ball high, hit a downward 'big high-five' spike so it bounces off the floor onto the wall, and catch the rebound.
1 soft volleyball per student, gym wall
배구 실전 게임 3선: 패스 앤 고·스파이크 탈옥(제일브레이크)·배틀십 서브
배구 네트, 소프트 배구공 다수, 고깔콘, 훌라후프(팀당 5개), 볼링핀(팀당 1~2개)
3 Top Volleyball Games: Pass & Go, Spike Jailbreak & Battleships Serving

1) Pass & Go: 3 feeders stand at the net; each passer moves laterally across 3 cones digging (then setting) a tossed ball back to each feeder, progressing to a 3-team race to complete 30 over-the-net digs into a net catcher's hands.
2) Spike Jailbreak: players toss and spike balls over the net from the attack line; if you hit the net/out or your spike is caught on the fly by a player in 'Jail' on the other side, you go to Jail while the catcher breaks out!
3) Battleships Serving: two teams serve continuously from behind the service line to bounce balls inside 5 target hula hoops on the opponent's court (retrieve each hit hoop), or knock down a corner pin for an instant win!
Volleyball net, volleyballs, cones, 10 hula hoops, 2–4 bowling pins
후프 틱택(Hoop Tic-Tac-Toe) 3×3 후프 마크 배치 및 상대 마크 되돌리기 전략 릴레이
Hoop Tic-Tac-Toe Relay with Opponent-Marker Removal Twist

1) Set up a 3×3 grid of 9 hula hoops at one end of the gym and give each team 4 colored pinnies (markers) at the start line.
2) Players relay one at a time (running or crab-walking) to place a marker inside an empty hoop and tag the next runner behind the start line.
3) First team to line up 3 markers horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins (settle simultaneous arrivals with Rock-Paper-Scissors).
4) Tactical Variation: on your turn at the grid, you may choose EITHER to place your own marker OR to pick up an opponent's marker and return it!
9 hula hoops, 4 team pinnies/markers per team
육각형 6골대 라바콘 격파 골대 뺏기 '땅따먹기 축구'

1) Set up a large hexagon court with 3 cones placed side-by-side at each of the 6 vertices (18 cones total = 6 goals).
2) Divide into 2 teams; each team starts owning 3 goals and receives 2 soccer balls (4 balls in play simultaneously).
3) Attackers dribble and kick to knock down a cone at any opposing goal; as soon as a cone falls, that entire 3-cone goal converts to the attacking team's ownership!
4) Only 1 defender may guard a goal at a time (no hands allowed); after 5 minutes, the team owning more goals wins.
18 tall cones, 4 soccer balls, team pinnies
2인 협동 상하좌우 이동 훌라후프 골대 무드리블 간이 농구
말랑한 바운스볼(폼 농구공) 1개, 훌라후프 2개, 팀 조끼
Moving Hula-Hoop Goal Pass-Only Modified Basketball

1) Divide into two 8-player teams; 2 players from each team stand along the opponent's endline holding a hula hoop together as a 'moving basketball hoop.'
2) Players advance the ball using PASSES ONLY (no dribbling allowed) so every teammate touches the ball.
3) Defenders must stay 1 meter away from the ball holder with zero physical contact (2 contact warnings = 2-minute penalty).
4) The 2 hoop-holders move the hula hoop up, down, left, or right to help their teammates' shots pass through the hoop for 1 point; play four 5-minute periods, rotating the hoop-holders each period.
1 soft foam basketball, 2 hula hoops, team pinnies

1) Set up a 4-base baseball diamond (Home, 1st, 2nd, 3rd) and place a basket of wristbands/rings at Home plate.
2) Students pair up at Home plate and play Rock-Paper-Scissors.
3) The winner hits a 'Home Run'—sprinting counterclockwise around 1st, 2nd, and 3rd base back to Home to put on 1 wristband before challenging a new partner.
4) The loser stays at Home plate to play RPS against another waiting player (or does jumping jacks if no partner is available); celebrate the first players to collect 2–5 wristbands!
한 손 펀스틱 맞잡고 가위바위보 스틱 추격전

1) Draw a center line and two outer safety lines; pairs face each other across the center line holding opposite ends of the same foam noodle with their left hands.
2) Play Rock-Paper-Scissors with your right hand.
3) On a tie, both players slide their grip closer toward the middle of the foam stick.
4) As soon as someone wins, the loser lets go of the stick, turns, and sprints for their safety line while the winner chases to tap their back once before they cross the safety line!
1 foam noodle (fun-stick) per pair, boundary lines/cones
점보 스태킹컵 하우스 슬라이딩 '실내 컬링 스태킹'
팀별 색깔 스태킹컵(점보컵 또는 일반 스태킹컵), 컬링 하우스 시트(또는 바닥 표적 원)
Indoor Curling-Stacking: Sliding Jumbo Cups into the House

1) Lay a curling house target sheet (or taped concentric circles) on a smooth classroom or gym floor, and seat teams behind the start line with colored jumbo stacking cups.
2) From a seated or kneeling position, slide your upside-down stacking cup smoothly along the floor toward the target rings.
3) Knock opposing cups out of the rings or curl your team's cups onto the center red button.
4) Score points at the end of each round based on the cups closest to the center of the house.
Colored jumbo or standard sport-stacking cups, curling house floor mat/tape
교실 3종 몸풀기 및 안대 모자 소리에 반응하는 스펀지스틱 술래잡기
스펀지스틱(폼누들) 1~2개, 모자 및 안대, 모서리 콘 4개, 바닥 매트
Inclusive Classroom Warm-Up & Sound-Guided Blindfold Foam-Stick Tag

1) Set up 4 corner cones in the classroom for a 3-part warm-up: (1) jog 3 laps around the cones, (2) high-knee skips (tapping knees up to a horizontal foam stick), and (3) touch-the-floor-and-jump reaches.
2) The tagger puts on a cap with a blindfold over their eyes and holds a soft foam stick.
3) Runners move around the classroom clapping their hands and calling out so the blindfolded tagger can locate them by sound.
4) When the tagger gently touches a runner with the foam stick, rotate taggers until every student has had a turn.
Soft foam stick (pool noodle), cap and blindfold, 4 cones, classroom mats
바닥 펀스틱 간이 네트 풍선공 1대1 3터치 손족구
짝당 펀스틱(스펀지스틱) 1개, 풍선공(패브릭 풍선볼 또는 풍선) 1개

1) Lay 1 foam noodle flat on the classroom or gym floor as a mini net between two players (1v1, or 2v2 in a larger space).
2) Rally a slow-moving balloon ball across the foam noodle using open hands.
3) Allow either zero bounces or 1 bounce on your side, and allow each player up to 3 consecutive self-touches to control and hit the ball over.
4) Play to 11 points, rotating opponents after each mini-match.
1 foam noodle (fun-stick) and 1 balloon ball per pair
3걸음 이동·팔벌려뛰기 5회 즉시복귀·1분 휴식존 개인전 서바이벌 피구
3-Step Individual Tag-Dodgeball with 5-Jumping-Jack Revive & 1-Min Rest Zone

1) Everyone scatters across the gym in an all-vs-all game as the teacher tosses 3 soft dodgeballs into play.
2) Any player who grabs a ball may take up to 3 steps and throw at anyone (except another player currently holding a ball—ball holders have a truce!).
3) If hit, perform 5 jumping jacks and immediately continue playing; if you catch an incoming throw in the air, skip the jumping jacks and immediately take 3 steps to counter-attack!
4) Designate a '1-Minute Rest Zone' on the sideline where tired students can catch their breath for up to 1 minute before jumping back in.
전원 1인 1공 다리 사이 공 굴려 구출하는 '굴려라 술래잡기'
Roll-to-Rescue Tag: 1 Ball Per Player & Leg-Tunnel Unfreeze

1) Every player—including the tagger—chooses and carries 1 ball (mix of large and small soft balls).
2) The tagger chases classmates and must touch them directly with the ball held in their hand (no throwing).
3) Tagged players become 'Statues' by holding their ball high overhead and standing with legs wide apart.

MEXT Lower-Grade Vaulting Box Play — Frog Vault, 'Ton-Ton' Takeoff, Rainbow Landing & Beam Hops

Coodi Sports 6 Indoor Ball Games — Circle Bounce, Kick Dodge, Dango Train & Pass-and-Duck

Coodi Sports 5 Indoor Rec Games — 9-Square Jump Tag, 4-Color Cone Sort, Chain Relay & Fake-Out Grab
