Players roll a foam ball so it stops inside one of their hoops to capture that hoop. Once a team captures all of its own hoops, it moves to the far-end cones to roll from the opposite side and steal remaining hoops from other teams.
4-5 Hula hoops per team, 1 foam ball per team, far-end cones
초등 체육 변형 볼링 수업 4선 — 장애물 커브 볼링·블라인드 코칭·스쿠터 볼링·하프라인 팀 볼
볼링핀(또는 라바콘), 폼볼, 접이식 매트(장애물용), 안대, 스쿠터 보드
4 Creative PE Bowling Variations — Obstacle, Blindfold Coaching, Scooter & Team Bowl

Four bowling variations: (1) Obstacle Bowling (curve or bank shots around a standing mat barrier), (2) Blindfold Partner-Coached Bowling (teammates guide the blindfolded bowler's alignment while the bowler focuses on kinesthetic arm swing), (3) Scooter Bowling, and (4) Team Bowl (two teams on opposite halves with 1 pin and 1 goalie each, rolling multiple balls to knock down the opponent's pin).
Plastic bowling pins or cones, foam balls, upright mat obstacle, blindfolds, scooter boards
듀드 퍼펙트 (Dude Perfect) — 6종 스포츠 트릭샷 스테이션 & 모둠 창의 챌린지
소형 파라슈트(타프), 하키 스틱·퍽, 농구공, 탁구공·컵, 폼 풋볼·바구니, 플라잉디스크·핀
Dude Perfect PE Trick-Shot Stations — 6 Skill Challenges & Student-Designed Shots

Set up 6 trick-shot stations around the gym: (1) Mini-Parachute Team Launch into a basketball hoop, (2) Hockey Sniper through a narrow barrier gap, (3) Rainbow/Backward Basketball Bank Shot, (4) Ping-Pong Bounce into Wall Cups, (5) Long Football Bin Toss, and (6) Flying-Disc Pin Knockdown on a table. Groups then invent and film their own custom trick-shot challenge.
Mini parachute/tarp, floorball sticks & pucks, basketballs, ping-pong balls & cups, football & bin, flying discs & pins
아이 씨 (I See) — '내 몸 주변 비눗방울' 개인 공간 인지와 상상 로코모터 이동 놀이
없음 (맨손, 음악 및 스피커, 코트 경계선)
I See' Personal-Bubble & Open-Space Locomotor Game (K-2)

Students imagine a giant protective 'bubble' around their body and practice steering into open space inside the boundary line without popping anyone's bubble. In a call-and-response ('I see!' / 'What do you see?'), the teacher prompts imaginative locomotor scenarios—walking a pet, galloping on a horse, swimming, ice skating, imaginary basketball, and tiptoeing past a sleeping monster—while music plays, freezing on the stop cue.
클래시 오브 더 카드 (The Clash of the Cards) — 4무늬 트럼프 카드 기억 뒤집기 릴레이
트럼프 카드 1벌(52장 + 조커 2장, 또는 대형 숫자/무늬 카드), 모둠 출발 콘 4개
The Clash of the Cards — 4-Suit Memory Flip & Secret Peek Relay

Four teams are each assigned one card suit (Diamonds, Clubs, Hearts, Spades) while a full deck of cards (plus 2 '+1' Jokers) is spread face-down across the gym floor. Runners sprint out one at a time and may flip over only ONE card: if it matches their team's suit (or is a Joker), they bring it back; if not, they secretly turn it face-down again and tag the next runner.
1 Deck of playing cards (or jumbo cards with 2 Jokers), 4 team cones
패스티스트 클래스 챌린지 (The Fastest Class Challenge) — 5분 학급 평균 트랙 완주 워밍업
코너용 라바콘 4개, 5분 타이머 화면, 계수기(카운터), 음악 스피커
The Fastest Class Challenge — 5-Minute Class-Average Lap Warm-Up

Set up 4 corner cones and a 5-minute timer with upbeat music. The entire class runs or power-walks laps around the perimeter for 5 minutes while the teacher clicks a tally counter every time any student completes a lap. Divide total laps by the number of students present to post the 'Average Laps per Student' on a grade-level leaderboard.
4 Corner cones, 5-minute display timer, tally counter, upbeat music
콘 플립 믹서 & 5단 점보 콘 플립 릴레이 — 승패 존중 스포츠맨십과 인터벌 달리기
소형 고깔콘 다수, 마지막 단계용 대형(점보) 라바콘 모둠당 1개
The Cone Flip Mixer & 5-Cone Progression Relay — Sportsmanship & Sprint Intervals

Part 1 (Mixer): Pairs take turns flipping a cone (up to 10 tries total). Whoever lands it upright first wins; both players exchange a fist-bump/high-five saying 'Good game!', the loser jogs 1 perimeter lap, and both find new partners. Part 2 (Relay): Teams sprint out one by one to flip a line of 4 small cones and 1 final jumbo cone upright—strictly 1 flip attempt per turn before sprinting back to tag the next runner.
Small flexible cones, 1 large/jumbo cone per relay team
치킨 타코 태그 (Chicken Taco Tag) — 원마커 타코 속에 고무닭 끼워 쫓는 2분 순발력 술래
Chicken Taco Tag — Poly-Spot & Rubber-Chicken Continuous Tag

Taggers fold a round poly spot in half like a taco shell with a rubber chicken (or beanbag/fish) tucked inside and chase classmates. When a runner is tagged, the tagger drops the poly spot and chicken on the floor; the newly tagged player must pick up both pieces, fold them back into a 'Chicken Taco,' and continue tagging for a 2-minute round.
2-4 Soft poly spots, 2-4 rubber chickens (or beanbags/toy fish)
바스켓볼 태그 (Basketball Tag) — 전원 농구 드리블 술래잡기 & 다리 사이 공 굴려 구출
Basketball Tag — All-Dribble Noodle Tag & Under-the-Legs Roll Rescue

Every student dribbles a basketball continuously inside the court, including the taggers, who dribble with one hand while holding a half-noodle in the other. When tagged, a player freezes with feet wide apart and their basketball held overhead. A teammate rescues them by dribbling over and rolling their basketball through the frozen player's legs (rescuers have safe immunity while rolling).
1 Basketball (or playground ball) per student, 2-3 foam noodles
고블고블 태그 (Gobble Gobble Tag) — 잠든 농부 깨우기 3단계 음량 외침과 10초 추격전
Gobble Gobble Tag — 3-Volume Wake-Up Call & 10-Second Farmer Blitz

One 'Farmer' tagger pretends to sleep in the center while all 'Turkeys' gather close and flap their wings. Turkeys chant 'Wobble, wobble, gobble, gobble!' three times: first in a whisper, second in a normal voice, and third at a loud shout. On the third shout, the Farmer wakes up and has 10 seconds to tag as many Turkeys as possible. All tagged players become sleeping Farmers for the next 10-second round until one Turkey remains.
서바이벌 태그 (Survivor Tag) — 나를 태그한 사람이 잡히면 즉시 부활하는 전원 술래잡기
Survivor Tag (Everybody's It) & Back-of-Knee Tag Variation

Every student is simultaneously a tagger and a dodger in open space. When you tap someone and call 'Tip!', they sit down on the spot. Seated players watch the person who tagged them—as soon as their tagger gets tagged by someone else, the seated player stands right back up into the game. Simultaneous tags are settled by rock-paper-scissors.
프라임 코칭 즉석 체육 워밍업 5선 — 4구역 존 태그·캥거루와 악어·사과 잡기·10초 스피드 체이서
Prime Coaching Top 5 PE Warm-Ups — Zone Tag, Kangaroos & Crocodiles, Grab the Apple & Speed Chasers

Five versatile warm-ups: (1) 4-Zone Tag (4 taggers restricted to their own quadrant while runners cross freely), (2) Kangaroos & Crocodiles (centerline reaction chase with fitness cues), (3) Court-Line Call Sprint, (4) Grab the Apple (pairs react to posture cues before grabbing or foot-trapping a ball on a cone when 'Ball!' is called), and (5) Speed Chasers (10-second blitz where 1-2 chasers enter a square to tag dodgers).
Cones, 1 ball per pair, foam noodles
킹 오브 더 링 녹아웃 (King of the Ring) — 하키·농구·축구 볼 키핑 & 2인 5생명 패스 변형
플로어볼/하키 스틱과 공(또는 축구공/농구공 1인 1개), 구역 경계 콘 15개 이상
King of the Ring Knockout — Hockey, Basketball & Soccer Ball-Control + 2-Player 5-Lives Pass Mode

Players control their own hockey ball, basketball, or soccer ball inside a coned ring while trying to knock opponents' balls out as the boundary gradually shrinks. Variation 1 (Tackler Time Trial): 2-3 ball-less tacklers try to clear all balls as fast as possible. Variation 2 (Partner Pass Mode): pairs share 1 ball with 5 lives, passing between each other to evade knockouts.
Floorball/hockey sticks & balls (or soccer/basketballs), 15+ boundary cones
이스터 에그 태그 (Easter Egg Tag) — 빈백 달걀 셀프 토스 & 박수 캐치 부활 술래잡기
Easter Egg Tag — Beanbag Self-Toss & Clap-Catch Revival Tag

Runners hold a beanbag ('egg') on the start line while taggers with short foam noodles guard the middle. When their color or group is called, runners sprint to the finish line to score 1 point. Any runner tagged along the way stops on the spot and performs 3 self-toss-and-catches (or toss-clap-catches) with their beanbag to revive and finish the run.
1 Beanbag per runner, 3-4 short foam noodles for taggers
에그 태그 (알-오리 진화 술래잡기) — 알 자세·오리걸음 가위바위보 자력 부활 술래
Egg Tag (Egg-to-Duck Evolution Tag) — Squat-Egg & Duck-Walk RPS Self-Revival

When tagged by a foam-noodle tagger, players squat and hug their knees on the spot as an 'Egg.' Two Eggs can play rock-paper-scissors: the winner evolves into a 'Duck' (moving via duck-walk) while the loser stays an Egg. Two Ducks then duck-walk to each other and play RPS—the winner evolves back into a human runner and the loser returns to an Egg.
2-3 Foam noodles for taggers, boundary poly spots
교실 무탈락 사일런트 볼 (침묵의 볼) — 묵언 패스·외곽 1바퀴 복귀 & 한손·왼손 챌린지
소프트 폼볼 2개, 개인 자리 표시용 미니 콘(인원수만큼)
Zero-Elimination Silent Ball — 2-Ball Quiet Pass, Perimeter Lap & One-Hand Challenge

Students stand at their spot cones in a circle in complete silence while passing 1, then 2 foam balls across the circle. Anyone who speaks, drops a catchable pass, or throws a second ball to someone already holding a ball jogs one lap around the outside of the circle and re-enters immediately. Progress to right-hand-only (left hand behind back) and left-hand-only rounds.
2 Soft foam balls, 1 spot cone per student
배드민턴·패드민턴 '후프에 쏙 서브 게임!' — 눈사람 후프 전진 이동 로테이션
배드민턴 또는 패드민턴 라켓·셔틀콕, 모둠당 훌라후프 2개, 출발 콘

Each group places 2 hula hoops touching end-to-end like a snowman in front of their serving line. Servers aim to land the shuttlecock inside the FAR hoop. Each time a serve lands inside the far hoop, the retriever moves the front hoop over the far hoop to advance the target one hoop-length farther away, then brings the shuttlecock back to the line for continuous rotation.
Badminton or paddleminton rackets & shuttlecocks, 2 hula hoops per team, start cones
9칸 동시 점프 술래 게임 '1가구 1주택!' (=나 혼자 산다!) — 박자 점프와 페인트 심리전
3×3 바닥 격자 라인(또는 테이프/후프 9개), 스톱워치, 팀조끼
9-Grid Rhythm Jump Tag 'One Household, One Home!' — Synchronized Jump & Feint Survival

On a 3x3 floor grid, runners start in separate squares while 1 tagger starts on the edge. On every '1, 2, 3!' chant, everyone jumps one square in any direction (the tagger may feint and stay in the same square). If a runner lands in the same square as the tagger—or if two runners land in the same square ('1 Household, 1 Home' rule)—they are out. Time how many seconds each squad survives.
3x3 Floor grid (tape or 9 hoops), stopwatch, pinnies
캥거루 가위바위보 피구 — 후프 양발 점프 대결 & 피트니스 미션 콘 쟁탈전
소프트 폼볼(또는 창의·인성 피구공), 훌라후프 징검다리, 득점용 미니 콘 다수
Kangaroo RPS Dodgeball — Two-Foot Hoop Jumps, Quick-Throw & Fitness Tasks

Players from two teams kangaroo-jump (two feet together) through a line of hula hoops to meet in the middle for rock-paper-scissors. The RPS winner grabs a point cone and kangaroo-jumps back across their safe line, while the RPS loser grabs a foam ball and throws from the center to hit the fleeing winner below the waist. If hit, the runner performs a quick fitness task; if missed, the thrower performs it.
Soft foam dodgeballs, hula hoops, scoring mini cones
투명 피구공 피하기 — 교사 손짓 반응 4방향 회피·점프·캐치 피구 준비운동
Dodge the Invisible Ball!' — Visual-Cue Reaction & Split-Step Dodgeball Warm-Up

The teacher holds 1 dodgeball in front of the class while students bounce on the balls of their feet. Students react instantly to the teacher's ball cues: (1) side throw motion = dodge the opposite way, (2) overhead lift = duck low, (3) floor bounce = jump wide, (4) switching the ball from one hand to the other = freeze still, and (5) a real two-hand toss to a student = catch and throw back.
공격자·수비자와 부산행! — 팔 뻗어 걷는 좀비 증식 술래와 안전 후프 기지
구역 표시용 콘 또는 안전지대 훌라후프
Train to Busan' Zombie-Walk Expanding Tag

Starts with 1 'Zombie' tagger who must walk with both arms stretched straight out in front. Runners also move by speed-walking or hopping inside the boundary lines. Anyone tagged—or anyone who steps out of bounds—immediately stretches both arms forward and joins the growing Zombie horde until only 3-5 survivors remain.
소인국 가위바위보 피구 — 무릎 굽혀 오리걸음 대결 & 바닥 굴리기 추격 피구
소프트 폼볼 2~4개, 득점용 미니 콘 다수, 출발·안전 라인
Lilliput (Duck-Walk) RPS Dodgeball — Low-Stance Chase & Roll-Throw

Players from both teams duck-walk ('Lilliput walk') to the centerline and play rock-paper-scissors. The winner grabs a scoring cone and duck-walks back toward their safe line while the loser grabs a foam ball and rolls/throws low from a crouched position to tag the fleeing player before they cross the line.
2-4 Soft foam balls, scoring mini cones, boundary lines
한 걸음, 두 걸음 스텝 술래잡기 — 구령에 맞춰 동시 보폭 이동하는 교실 두뇌 술래
One-Step, Two-Step' Simultaneous Stride Tag — Classroom Balance & Distance Game

A zero-running classroom tag game: whenever the tagger calls 'One Step!' (or 'Two Steps!'), both the tagger and all dodgers take strictly 1 (or 2) giant steps simultaneously and freeze in balance. If the tagger can reach and tap a player with a foam noodle from their landing spot, roles switch (after nearby players take 1 buffer step back).
교실 가가볼 (Gagaball) — 팔각형 간이 경기장 손바닥 타격 무릎 아래 서바이벌 피구
소프트 배구공/폼볼 1~2개, 팔각형 벽면용 접이식 판 또는 교실 의자/우유상자
Classroom Gagaball — Octagon Pit Open-Palm Strike Dodgeball

Form an octagonal Gaga pit in the classroom or gym using folding boards, milk crates, or tipped chairs. Players start touching the wall; the teacher drops the ball in for 3 bounces ('Ga-Ga-Ball!') with a 5-second no-out grace period. Players may only strike or roll the ball with an open palm (no catching/throwing and no double-touches) to hit opponents below the knee.
1-2 Soft volleyballs or foam balls, octagon pit barriers (folding boards/crates/chairs)
사냥꾼을 피해라! — 폼볼 투척 사냥꾼·나무 자세 2인 구출·후프 쉼터 밀어내기 태그
소프트 폼볼 3~4개, 안전 쉼터용 훌라후프 4개, 사냥꾼용 팀조끼 3~4벌
Avoid the Hunters! — Foam-Ball Hunter Tag, 2-Touch Tree Rescue & Hoop Shelter Bump

Three or four 'Hunters' wear pinnies and carry soft foam balls, while the rest of the class are 'Animals' with 4 hula-hoop shelters spread on the floor. Hunters run and throw foam balls to hit Animals below the waist. Hit Animals freeze with both arms out as a 'Tree' until 2 different teammates each tap one arm down to revive them. One Animal may rest safe inside a hoop shelter until another Animal runs up and yells 'Out!', forcing the resting player to flee to a different hoop.
3-4 Soft foam balls, 4 hula hoops (shelters), 3-4 pinnies
진(陣)부활 피구 — 이동 금지 패스 피구 & 상대 진영 감옥 노바운드 캐치 부활전
소프트 폼볼 6개, 양 진영(감옥) 표시용 접시콘, 2색 팀조끼
Base-Revival Dodgeball (Jin-Revival) — Pivot-Pass Dodgeball & No-Bounce Jail Catch

Two teams roam the entire court with 6 foam balls in play and a coned Base/Jail zone at each end. Players holding a ball cannot walk and must pass to moving teammates to hit opponents. Hit players sit inside the opponent's Base/Jail and revive by catching a no-bounce air pass from a live teammate, raising one hand ('twinkle hand') while jogging outside the court back to their home base.
6 Soft foam balls, cones for 2 endzone bases/jails, 2-color pinnies
변형 발야구 '킥볼 (Kickball)' — 7m 안전지대 왕복 주루 & 피구형 수비 전원타격제
소프트 배구공 또는 발야구공 1개, 홈·안전지대·파울라인용 라바콘 6개
Modified Kickball (Kick-Dodge) — 7m Safe-Zone Shuttle Running & All-Batter Innings

Simplifies kickball by replacing 4 bases with a Home line and a Safe Zone line 7m (10 paces) away. The pitcher rolls the ball; the kicker kicks it and runs to the Safe Zone, where multiple runners may wait before sprinting back across Home for 1 point each. Fielders get runners out by catching fly balls, tagging runners, or throwing the soft ball to hit runners below the waist between lines. All players kick each inning.
1 Soft volleyball or kickball, 6 cones for Home, Safe Zone, and 45-degree foul lines
공 1개 누적 패스 20회 게임 — 드리블 금지·큰 소리 카운트 자기주도 심판 영역형 게임
소프트 농구공/배구공 코트당 1개, 사각형 경기장용 라바콘 4개, 팀조끼
20-Pass Cumulative Keep-Away — No-Dribble Netball Lead-Up & Self-Officiated Counting

In a 3v3 or 4v4 coned square with 1 ball and man-to-man defense, the attacking team passes the ball with no dribbling allowed. Every completed pass adds 1 point, and the entire team must shout the cumulative count aloud ('1, 2, 3...'). Turnovers switch possession, and when a team regains the ball, they resume counting from their previous score until one team reaches 20 total passes.
1 Soft basketball/volleyball per court, 4 boundary cones, pinnies
말미잘 술래잡기 — 잡힌 자리에 뿌리내려 양팔 촉수로 가로막는 턴제 돌파 술래
술래용 소프트 터치 미트(또는 펀스틱/스태킹컵), 안전지대 원마커 라인
Sea Anemone Tag — Stationary Tentacle-Arm Blockers & Turn-Based Breakthrough

Safe zones are marked at both ends of the gym with 1 mobile tagger in the center. On each whistle turn, runners sprint from one safe zone to the other. Any runner tagged freezes permanently on that exact floor spot as a 'Sea Anemone.' On subsequent turns, Sea Anemones must keep both feet planted on their spot while waving their arms like tentacles to tag passing runners alongside the mobile tagger.
Soft tagging mitts (or foam noodles/cups), safe-zone floor markers
소프트발리볼(50~100g), 배드민턴 지주 및 낮은 네트, 팀조끼, 작전판
MEXT Upper-Grade Soft Volleyball — 3v3 Catch, One-Bounce & Three-Hit Progression

Played 3v3 (4-5 players per team rotating on each point) using a soft 50-100g volleyball. Teams progress across Stage 1 (Catch Volleyball where the 2nd player catches and tosses a set), Stage 2 (One-Bounce allowed), and Stage 3 (No-Bounce 3-touch Soft Volleyball), starting rallies with an underhand rainbow toss serve and self-officiating.
Soft volleyballs (50-100g), low nets on badminton posts, pinnies, team strategy boards
문부과학성 고학년 멀리뛰기 — 7보 리듬 도움닫기 & 배꼽 리드 착지
모래장, 넓은 구름판, 고무줄 바(높이·거리 표시용), 미니허들, 고무래, 줄자
MEXT Upper-Grade Long Jump — 7-Step Rhythm Approach & Belly-Lead Landing

Students run a 15-20m (or 7-step) rhythmic approach, quickening the final 3 steps ('ta-ta-tan!') to take off from a wide 30-50cm zone. Leading with their belly button over an elastic cord or mini-hurdle, they tuck knees in flight and land on both feet in a forward-leaning 'U' posture.
Sandpit, wide takeoff board/zone, elastic cords, mini-hurdles, rake, measuring tape
문부과학성 저학년 몸풀기 체조 — 화물열차 달팽이 & 풍선 협동 랠리
MEXT Lower-Grade Body Loosening — Cargo-Train Spiral & Co-op Balloon Rally

Students march to a tambourine beat, form groups on whistle counts, link into a Rock-Paper-Scissors Cargo Train, and wind into a giant spiral. Seated in a circle, they perform back-tap and shampoo massages, a circle domino lean, giraffe partner stretches, and finish with a cooperative group balloon keep-up rally.
문부과학성 저학년 표현·리듬 놀이 — 거울 댄스 & 동물 나라 모험 즉흥 표현
없음(맨손, 경쾌한 배경 음악 및 오디오)
MEXT Lower-Grade Expressive Rhythm Play — Mirror Dance & Animal Land Adventure

Starts with facial/full-body rhythm warm-ups and partner mirror dancing, followed by 3-step rock/seaweed rolls, 'Pumpkin Seed to Watermelon' growth RPS, 'Knock-Knock Character Transform', and an 'Animal Land Adventure' where students fly like airplanes and embody heavy elephants, tiny mice, crabs, octopuses, and sprinting cheetahs.
No equipment (upbeat background music and audio player)
문부과학성 저학년 철봉 운동 놀이 — 철봉 랜드 6개 코스 패스포트 챌린지
낮은 철봉, 안전 매트, 철봉 패스포트 카드, 보조 벨트(긴 타올), 착지 표시 라인
MEXT Lower-Grade Horizontal Bar Play — 'Tetsubo Land' 6-Station Passport

Students rotate through 6 'Tetsubo Land' stations with a skill passport: (1) Jump-support & swing-back dismount, (2) Swallow front-support hold, (3) Pillbug, Roast-Pork & Bat hang (with Bat RPS), (4) Leg-through circle & forward roll dismount, (5) Futon-fold hang & swing, and (6) Monkey 4-limb swing plus 2-move combinations.
Low horizontal bars, gym mats, skill passport cards, towel support straps
문부과학성 고학년 체조·몸풀기 — 다부위 풍선 협동 랠리 & 원형 일어서기
MEXT Upper-Grade Body Conditioning — Multi-Part Balloon Rally & Sync Stand-Up

Includes feint-step evasion tag, a cooperative group balloon keep-up rally using hands, feet, and heads, partner post-exercise relaxation massage and breathing, synchronized circle hand-linked stand-ups, and cooperative long-rope jumping while passing a ball.
Balloons, long jump ropes, soft balls, gym mats
문부과학성 고학년 체력 기르기 4대 영역 — 외바퀴 손수레 3단계 & 5분 줄넘기
개인 줄넘기, 긴줄넘기, 거리별 라인(테이프/콘), 초시계
MEXT Upper-Grade 4-Pillar Fitness — Fewest-Step Wheelbarrow & 5-Min Jump Rope

Students rotate through 4 fitness pillars: (1) Agility/Coordination (jumping a short rope while entering a turning long rope + quick-feet drills), (2) Muscular Strength (partner wheelbarrow walk aiming to cross Line 1 in <=3 hand-steps, Line 2 in <=5 steps, Line 3 in <=7 steps), (3) Flexibility (heel-down calf/Achilles stretch), and (4) Endurance (5-minute continuous jump rope).
Short jump ropes, long jump ropes, floor distance lines, timer
문부과학성 고학년 철봉 연속기 — 오르기·회전·내리기 3단 콤비네이션
철봉, 착지용 안전 매트, 기술 조합 기록 카드
MEXT Upper-Grade Horizontal Bar — 3-Skill Mount, Circle & Dismount Routine

After synchronized partner warm-ups on the bar, students design and perform a smooth 3-skill routine combining a Mount (pullover or single-leg swing-up), a Circle skill (forward/backward hip circle or knee circle), and a Dismount (single-foot swing-off landing) without pausing between moves.
Horizontal bars, landing mats, routine builder cards
우천 실내 체육 10종 서킷 — 티슈 배에 붙이고 대시 & 매듭 수건공 원피구
10 Rainy-Day Indoor PE Games — Tissue Belly Dash & Knotted-Towel Dodgeball

A 10-part indoor movement circuit: (1) Cue-inhibition hand game, (2) Animal walks tag (inchworm, bear, alligator, spider, otter), (3) Radish pull, (4) Partner jump-over & crawl-under race, (5) 16-beat shoulder rhythm song, (6) Color association touch, (7) Tissue Belly Dash (sprint fast enough that a tissue stays flat on your stomach without hands), (8) Tissue drop catch, (9) Knotted-towel cone knockdown, and (10) Towel-ball circle dodgeball.
Facial tissues (1 per student), knotted hand towels/scarves, cones
コーディスポーツ【愉しいを創る】
코디네이션 트레이닝 7선 — 등 맞대고 일어서기·생선 뒤집기·마리오네트
7 Fun Coordination Drills — Back-to-Back Stand, Fish Flip & Marionette Jump

Seven quick coordination warm-ups: (1) Partner back-to-back synchronized stand-up, (2) Jump-over & crawl-under switch, (3) Marionette cross-limb jump punch, (4) Rolling ball dodge jumps, (5) 'Fish Flip' prone core hold resistance, (6) Color-call ball drop catch, and (7) Pat-head/rub-belly hand switch ('Tonton-Surisuri').
Colored foam balls, poly spots or mats
コーディスポーツ【愉しいを創る】
실내 강당 체육 게임 5선 — 4열 볼 컬러 체인지 & 다리 터널 킥 릴레이
5 High-Energy Indoor Gym Games — Ball Color Swap, Walk-Only 3v1 & Kick Tunnel

Five indoor games: (1) 4-Line Ball Color-Swap Relay, (2) Ring-Ball 3x3 Bingo Relay, (3) 4-Team Center Ball Raid (first team to collect 3 balls into their hoop wins), (4) 3v1 Walk-Only 4-Cone Guard, and (5) Kick-Tunnel Relay (roll/kick the ball through teammates' wide legs and sprint to the front to receive it).
Colored foam/mini balls, hula hoops, cones
コーディスポーツ【愉しいを創る】
초등 두뇌·이색 변형 릴레이 4선 — 마커 1회 교환 색맞추기 & 조끼 겹쳐입기
색깔별 원마커(또는 접시콘), 라바콘, 팀조끼 여러 벌
4 Brainy & Quirky Relays — 1-Swap Color Sort & Multi-Bib Relay

Four relay variations where strategy beats raw speed: (1) 1-Swap Marker Color-Sort Relay (each runner swaps two markers in a vertical line until all colors are grouped), (2) 3-Marker Bingo Relay, (3) Student-Designed Zigzag & Jump Course Relay, and (4) Multi-Layer Bib Relay (putting on and passing layered pinnies at the exchange zone).
Colored poly spots/cones, tall cones, multiple pinnies per team
단거리 달리기(카케코) 5선 — 신체부위 잡고 뛰기 & 1발자국 핸디캡 대결
5 Sprint Training Games — Body-Hold Arm-Swing Discovery & 1-Foot Handicap Dash

Five sprint menus: (1) Multi-Direction Dash (forward, lateral, backward, 360-spin start, mid-run 180-turn), (2) Visual/Opposite Cue Reaction Dash, (3) Body-Part Hold Dash (running with hands on head, belly, or hips before swinging arms freely to feel how arm drive powers sprinting), (4) 1-Foot Handicap Pair Dash (winner moves 1 shoe-length back each race), and (5) Whistle Cutback Dash.
창의 변형 술래잡기 18선 — 마모루쿤(3인 호위 술래) & 콘 터치 이동 술래
18 Creative Tag Variations — 'Mamoru-kun' 3-Guard Shield Tag & Cone-Touch Tag

Features innovative Japanese PE tag games including: (1) Lion & Rabbit prone/seated reaction chase, (2) Pair-Link Slice Tag, (3) Cone-Touch Moving Safe-Zone Tag, (4) 'Mamoru-kun' (3 linked teammates rotate as a human shield to protect 1 designated teammate from a solo tagger), and (5) Color Hoop & Cone-Flip Tag.
【教育チャンネル】SSG教育サークル
앵콜 폭발 스피드 술래잡기 10선 — 전자레인지 땡·콘센트 땡·도키도키 술래
10 Encore Speed Tag Games — 'Microwave Ding!' Rescue, Outlet Tag & Secret Tagger

Ten fast 30-60 second tag games: (1) Increase Tag, (2) RPS Increase Tag, (3) 4-Player Split Linked Tag, (4) Clap Freeze Tag, (5) Leg-Tunnel Freeze Tag, (6) Leapfrog Freeze Tag, (7) 'Outlet!' Arm-Plug Freeze Tag, (8) 'Microwave Ding!' 2-Player Hug-Circle Rescue Tag, (9) Banana Peel Tag, and (10) Eyes-Closed Secret Tagger ('Dokidoki Tag').
왜키 베이스볼(Whacky Baseball) — 동심원 이중 베이스 주루 & 전원 스톱스팟 수비
훌라후프 4개(베이스), 접시콘 4개(내야 수비 원), 원마커(스톱스팟), 폼볼, 플라스틱 배트
Whacky Baseball — Concentric Circle Base-Running & Stop-Spot Fielding

Uses an inner fielding cone diamond inside an outer base-hoop diamond across 3 builds: Build 1 (counter-clockwise base runner vs clockwise fielding pass relay), Build 2 (throw-in fielding where all fielders must claim a Stop Spot poly spot and return the ball to the center hoop to freeze runners), and Build 3 (teammate-pitched batting with 4 attempts; 4 misses = automatic walk to 1st base).
4 Hula hoops (bases), 4 cones (inner relay), poly spots (Stop Spots), foam ball, plastic bat
스트라이커 볼(Striker Ball) — 원형 2콘 골문 수비 & 손바닥 바닥 타격
접시콘/라바콘(인당 2개), 잘 튀는 폼볼 또는 피구공 1~2개
Striker Ball — Circle 2-Cone Goal Defense & Open-Palm Floor Striking

Players stand in a large circle, each guarding a personal goal gate between two cones. Using open-palm floor strikes only (no catching or kicking), players hit the ball across the circle to score through opponents' cone gates. Conceding a goal means jogging one lap around the outside of the circle and rejoining immediately.
서바이벌 발야구(Survival Kickball) — 1인 수비에서 증식하는 전원참여 킥볼

The entire class starts in the kicking line while the teacher starts as the lone pitcher/fielder. Any kicker who fouls, misses a fair pitch, or gets caught/tagged/forced out immediately joins the fielding team, making defense tougher each turn until one final survivor remains.
1 Soft kickball/soccer ball, 4 base poly spots
4코너 사분면 흡수 피구(4-Corner Dodgeball) — 코트 통합형 무탈락 피구
4-Corner Quadrant Absorption Dodgeball — Merging-Court Zero-Elimination Game

Cones divide the gym into 4 quadrants for 4 teams. When hit below the waist by a foam ball, you immediately join the quadrant team that hit you. Once a quadrant loses its last player, the dividing cones are removed so the winning team claims half the gym until one quadrant absorbs everyone.
4-6 Soft foam balls, 12-16 cones for cross-court lines
핀 녹오버(Pin Knockover) — 수비 금지선 볼링핀·콘 투척 무너뜨리기
Pin Knockover — No-Guard-Zone Target Pin Showdown

Two teams line up 5-6 bowling pins or tall cones along their backline behind a marked no-guard zone. Staying on their half of the gym, players roll, underhand toss, or overhand throw foam balls to knock down all opposing pins first.
10-12 Plastic bowling pins (or tall cones), 6-10 soft foam balls
스쿠터보드 술래잡기(Scooter Tag) — 5회 제자리 회전 즉시 부활 태그
Scooter Tag — 5-Spin Instant Revival Scooter-Board Chase

Every student rides a scooter board (seated or kneeling) while 2-3 penny-wearing taggers chase. When tagged, a player spins 5 times in place on their scooter (or performs 5 jumping jacks) and immediately re-enters the game.
플라잉디스크 투척·캐치 4대 큐 & 순환 스테이션 수업
소프트 플라잉디스크, 훌라후프, 접시콘/라바콘, 스테이션 안내판
Flying Disc Throwing & Catching Cues + 4-Station Rotation

Students learn the Frisbee grip ('Thumb on top, fingers in the scoop'), 4-step backhand cue ('Point shoulder, Cross body, Step, Flick wrist'), and 'Crab Claws / Alligator Catch', then rotate through 4 skill stations (partner catch, hula-hoop target rings, cone knockdown, and leading passes).
Soft flying discs, hula hoops, cones, station task signs
음악 큐 기반 체육 스테이션 로테이션 — 정리·다음 번호 가리키기 시스템
번호 라바콘(1~6번), 화이트보드 콘 슬리브(과제 카드), 줄넘기·후프·폼볼, 오디오
Music-Cue PE Station Rotation — Clean-Up & Point-to-Next-Cone System

Students rotate through 6 numbered perimeter skill stations (jump rope, hula hoops, target toss, balance, agility). When music plays, students practice; when music stops, they clean up equipment within 5 seconds, sit, and point their finger toward the next numbered cone before rotating on the whistle.
Numbered cones (1-6), visual cone task sleeves, jump ropes, hoops, foam balls, music player
저학년 교구 활용 풍선 타격 4스테이션 — 원마커 외발 고정 25회 챌린지
풍선(인당 1개), 폼 패들 라켓, 플라스틱 볼링핀, 플라잉디스크, 펀스틱, 원마커
K-2 Striking Balloons With 4 Implements & Poly-Spot 1-Foot Glue Challenge

Lower-grade students rotate through 4 striking implement stations (foam paddle, bowling pin, frisbee, foam noodle) aiming for 50 consecutive upward hits. Next, they keep one foot 'glued' to a poly spot for 25 controlled hits before partnering up for an over-the-line balloon rally.
Balloons, foam paddles, bowling pins, flying discs, foam noodles, poly spots
훌라후프 마스터(Hula Hoop Master) — 3초 안전섬 수거 술래잡기
Hula Hoop Master — Shrinking Safe-Island Noodle Tag

Runners evade foam-noodle taggers by standing inside floor hula hoops for up to 3 seconds (1 player per hoop; 3 jumping jacks if tagged). Meanwhile, a 'Hula Hoop Master' carries a cone and collects any unoccupied hoops, shrinking the available safe islands over a 2-minute round.
15-20 Hula hoops, 2-3 foam noodles, 2 tall cones for hoop stacking
아이스크림 콘 릴레이 — 거꾸로 든 라바콘 위 공 밸런스 & 발로 얹기 미션
소형 고깔콘(아이스크림 콘용) 모둠당 1개, 폼볼/배구공 모둠당 1개, 반환점 콘
Ice Cream Cone Relay — Inverted-Cone Ball Balance & Foot-Only Recovery

Runners hold an inverted cone like an ice cream cone with a ball balanced on top, weaving through cones and passing it to the next teammate. If the ball drops, the runner must sit down and use only their feet (no hands!) to place the ball back onto the cone before continuing.
1 Small cone and 1 foam/volleyball per team, slalom cones
프로텍트 더 캐슬(Protect the Castle) — 노바운드 캐치 시 성벽 콘 부활
라바콘 7~10개(성벽용), 원 경계 마커, 소프트폼볼 2~3개, 팀조끼
Protect the Castle — Air-Catch Cone-Revival Target Defense Game

Outer-circle attackers pass and throw 2-3 foam balls to knock down 7+ center castle cones guarded by 2-3 Knights. Whenever a Knight catches an incoming throw on the fly without a bounce, they earn the right to stand one fallen castle cone back up.
7-10 Tall castle cones, boundary markers, 2-3 foam balls, pinnies
더 넘버스 게임(The Numbers Game) — 호명 번호 골대 왕복 터치 후 축구·농구·하키 대결
축구공(또는 농구공·플로어볼 세트), 미니 골대 2~4개, 접시콘, 팀조끼
The Numbers Game — Goal-Touch Sprint Entry 1v1 to 3v3 Invasion Game

Two teams line up on opposite endlines with numbered players (1, 2, 3...) and a ball in the center. When the teacher calls one or more numbers, those players sprint to touch the opposite goal and their own goal (or run around the perimeter) before entering the court to battle 1v1, 2v2, or 3v3 in soccer, basketball, or hockey.
Soccer ball (or basketball/floorball sticks), 2-4 mini goals, cones, pinnies
불 러시(Bull Rush) — 엔드존 돌파 & 허리 조끼 꼬리 뺏기 워밍업
안전지대 표시용 콘 10개, 팀조끼(또는 허리 꼬리끈) 인원수
Bull Rush — End-to-End Safe-Zone Breakthrough & Bib-Tail Snatch Tag

Runners line up in one endzone while 2 tippers wait in the middle. When the tippers yell 'Bull Rush!', everyone sprints across to the opposite safe zone. Tagged runners join the middle tippers; in Variation 2, everyone tucks a bib tail into their waistband for non-contact tail-snatching.
10 Cones for safe zones, pinnies/tail ribbons for each player
크로스 더 리버(Cross the River) — 조건 호명 도강 & 언더암 볼 롤링 피하기
작은 소프트폼볼/테니스공 10개 이상, 경계선 콘 12개, 농구공/축구공(변형 시)
Cross the River — Conditional Call & Underarm Ball-Roll Dodge

The teacher calls 'Cross the river if...' (e.g., wearing red shorts), prompting matching students—and then the rest of the class—to cross to the far endzone while sideline rollers roll small foam balls along the floor to tag feet. Tagged runners join the sideline rollers.
10+ Small foam balls, 12 boundary cones, basketballs/soccer balls (optional)
와스피털(Waspital) — 양손 반창고 3세이프 병원 체력 미션 부활 술래
병원 구역(Waspital) 표시용 콘 5개, 말벌 술래용 조끼 2~3벌

Every player's two hands act as two 'Band-Aids'. On the 1st tag by a Wasp, cover the tagged spot with one hand and keep running; on the 2nd tag, cover with the second hand; on the 3rd tag, visit the 'Waspital' cone zone to complete 10 star jumps or a 20-second single-leg balance to restore both hands.
5 Cones for the Waspital zone, 2-3 pinnies for Wasps
스피드 앉아 점프 피구 — 교실·강당 제자리 점프 회피 & 빠른 공수 전환
부드러운 소프트폼볼 1~2개, 구역 경계선(라인 또는 원마커)
Speed Seated-Jump Dodgeball — Low-Posture Jump Evasion in Small Spaces

Designed for classrooms or compact gym zones: inner dodgers stay in a low seated/squat posture and evade exclusively by jumping upwards or ducking in place, while outer throwers pass rapidly and roll or throw soft foam balls low at the feet.
1-2 Ultra-soft foam balls, boundary tape or poly spots
피라미드 가위바위보 돌파 달리기 — 다단계 수비벽 관문 통과
Pyramid RPS Breakthrough Sprint — Tiered Defense Gate Challenge

Defenders stand in pyramid rows (e.g., 4 guards in Row 1, 3 in Row 2, 2 in Row 3, and 1 King at the apex). Attackers sprint through each tier by winning Rock-Paper-Scissors; a loss sends the runner jogging back along the outside sideline to start at Row 1 again, while beating the apex King scores 1 team point.
Cones for tier lines and scoring gate, pinnies
훌라후프 투호 릴레이 — 스펀지 창·빈백 과녁 투척 전통놀이 변형
훌라후프(거치대 콘 포함), 펀스틱(스펀지봉) 또는 콩주머니, 투척선 콘

A modern PE adaptation of Korean traditional Tuho: teammates relay to a throwing line and toss foam noodles (safe javelins) or beanbags through upright or floor-arranged hula-hoop targets at tiered distances.
Hula hoops with cone holders, foam noodles or beanbags, throwing-line cones
스틱 픽업 런(Stick Pick-Up Run) — 쓰러지는 스틱 순발력 캐치 & 왕복 릴레이
플라스틱 스틱 또는 펀스틱(모둠당 1개), 원마커, 출발선 접시콘
Stick Pick-Up Run — Falling-Stick Reaction Sprint Relay
A runner balances a stick vertically on a forward poly spot and releases it on cue while calling the next teammate, who must sprint from the start line and catch the stick before it hits the floor.
1 Dowel/foam stick per group, poly spots, start-line cones
하이파이브 배려 달리기 — 느린 친구 쪽으로 더 뛰어 만나는 심폐지구력 왕복달리기
라바콘 4개(모둠당), 팀조끼, 접시콘 또는 콩주머니(변형 시)
High-Five Caring Shuttle Run — Inclusive Cardio Endurance Team Relay

A cooperative shuttle-run progression: in Activity 1 (pairs 10m apart) and Activity 2 (4 teammates at the corners of a square), players run inward to high-five (or stack hands for 4 players) and loop around their corner cone 5 times. Faster runners run deeper toward slower teammates' corners so everyone finishes together faster.
4 Cones per squad, pinnies, beanbags or disc cones (optional)
공 패스 술래잡기 — 체스트·바운드 패스 중 호루라기 신호 추격전
Ball-Pass Tag — Chest & Bounce Pass Drill into Instant Whistle Chase

Pairs stand 2-3m apart passing a ball back and forth (chest pass, bounce pass, overhead pass) on a single whistle. When the teacher blows a double whistle, whoever holds the ball becomes the chaser and must tag their fleeing partner with the ball before the stop whistle (loser does 5 squat jumps).
1 Basketball or foam ball per pair, whistle
진놀이 잡을까 말까? — 라바콘 탈환 눈치싸움 & 수비 돌진 페널티
보물용 라바콘 1개, 출발선 표시용 접시콘, 팀조끼 2색
Grab It or Not? — Territory Cone-Raid & Defender-Commit Penalty Game

Attackers advance toward a single cone placed 2-3m in front of the defensive line. Once an attacker touches the cone, all defenders may chase freely (bringing the cone home scores 1 point). However, if a defender rushes out BEFORE the cone is touched and fails to tag any attacker, that defender is eliminated! Teams get 3 cone-grab attempts per inning.
가위바위보 점수 사냥꾼 — 이기면 콘 획득 도주, 지면 피구공 추격 투척
모둠당 라바콘 4~5개(점수용), 소프트 피구공 1개, 공 받침용 접시콘
RPS Score Hunter — Win to Raid the Cone, Lose to Throw the Dodgeball

Two challengers meet at center court for Rock-Paper-Scissors. The winner grabs a scoring cone and sprints for their home line, while the loser sprints to grab a foam dodgeball resting on a tee-cone and throws it to tag the runner before they cross home safe.
4-5 Scoring cones per court, 1 soft foam ball, disc cones
두 팀 가위바위보 차등 반환점 릴레이 — 이기면 지름길, 지면 먼 콘 돌기
라바콘 4개, 팀조끼 2색(첫 주자 표시용 추가 조끼 포함)
Two-Team RPS Shortcut vs Long-Loop Relay

Four cones are placed in a line (Team A Far Cone - Team A Start - Team B Start - Team B Far Cone). Runners sprint to the opposing team's start cone and play full-body RPS: winners turn around immediately for a short return, while losers must run all the way around the far back cone before tagging their next teammate.
강당 미식피구(3볼 개인전) — 3보 이내 투척 & 노바운드 캐치 순차 부활

Starts by tossing 3 soft dodgeballs into the air for an all-vs-all game. Ball holders may take up to 3 steps before throwing. Hit players sit in order on the sideline bench; whenever any player on the court catches a thrown ball in the air, the first player in the bench queue re-enters the game.
교실 경보 술래잡기 '좀비와 비밀 천사' — 2분 걷기 추격 & 천사 몰래 구출
Classroom Walk-Only 'Zombies & Secret Angels' Rescue Tag

With heads down, the teacher secretly taps 3 Angels, then announces 2 Zombies and starts a 2-minute timer. Walking only is allowed between desks. Citizens tagged by Zombies sit in place, while Secret Angels discreetly tap seated Citizens to revive them without revealing their identity to the Zombies. If 10+ Citizens survive 2 minutes, Citizens win.
다람쥐 도토리 모으기 술래잡기 — 도토리 3개 모으면 탈락자 전원 부활!
펀스틱 1~2개, 훌라후프 1개, 원마커(학생 수-1개), 콩주머니(도토리) 인원수
Squirrel & Acorn Rescue Tag — Collect 3 Beanbag Acorns to Revive Everyone!

A hunter holding a foam stick starts in a center hoop while squirrels stand on perimeter poly spots holding 1 beanbag ('acorn') each. On 'Hunter!', squirrels dash to new spots. If tagged, a squirrel leaves their acorn on a spot and steps out; whenever an active squirrel collects 3 acorns and yells 'Three!', all eliminated classmates revive at once.
1-2 Foam sticks, 1 hula hoop, poly spots, beanbags (1 per student)
3인 훌라후프 징검다리 협력 릴레이 — 두발 멀리뛰기 착지 & 후프 길 잇기

In trios with 3 hula hoops, jumper #1 performs two-foot standing broad jumps from hoop to hoop while teammates #2 and #3 continuously pick up the rear hoop and place it ahead to build a stepping-stone bridge to the turnaround cone and back.
3 Hula hoops per trio, turnaround cones
링아 선을 넘지 마! — 강당 라인 근접 플로어 링·원마커 슬라이딩 컬링
고무 링 또는 원마커(모둠별 색상 구분), 강당 바닥 라인
Ring, Don't Cross the Line! — Cliffhanger Floor-Ring Sliding Target Game

Players slide rubber rings or poly spots along the floor toward a target floor line. In Round 1, closest to the line wins; in Round 2 ('Don't Cross the Line!'), any ring that slides completely past the target line is eliminated (0 points), rewarding precise force control.
Colored rubber rings or poly spots, gym floor lines
협력·배려 요가 술래잡기 — 나무·비행기·보트 V싯 요가 자세 동행 구출
Cooperative Yoga Tag — 3-Second Shared Tree, Airplane & Boat-Pose Rescue

When tagged, players freeze in a designated yoga balance pose (Tree pose, Airplane scale, or seated V-sit Boat pose). To rescue a frozen classmate, a teammate must stand or sit face-to-face and hold the exact same yoga pose together for 3 counts.
2 Foam sticks or pinnies for taggers
댄스 & 운동 가위바위보 — 이기면 승리 댄스, 비기면 스쿼트, 지면 점핑잭
Dance & Fitness RPS — Win to Dance, Tie for Squats, Lose for Jumping Jacks

Students play Rock-Paper-Scissors against the teacher or a partner with three active outcomes every round: Winners perform a celebration dance (e.g., Floss or rhythm swing), Ties perform 5 squats, and Losers perform 5-10 jumping jacks or burpees before immediately finding a new partner.
집중! 3색 콘 픽업 3종 대결 — 고깔콘·접시콘 색깔 매칭 & 순서 기억
Focus! 3-Color Cone Pick-Up Trio — Color Match, Double Grab & Sequence Sort

In trios at a desk (1 caller, 2 players with hands behind backs): Game 1 (caller places a colored tall cone; first player to cap it with the matching disc cone scores), Game 2 (caller drops 1 or 2 disc cones; players grab the matching tall cones), and Game 3 (arrange 3 tall cones to match the caller's 3-color sequence).
3-color small cones and matching 3-color disc cones, classroom desk
관계중심 원형 짐볼 피구 — 1분 버티기·학급 공동 생존시간 더하기
Relationship-Building Circle Gym-Ball Dodgeball — Survival Timer & Class Goal

Students form a large circle and roll a giant stability ball across to tag center dodgers across 3 modes: (1) Survive for 60 seconds, (2) Class Cooperative Goal (add everyone's survival seconds together to beat a class target), and (3) Team Total Survival Time comparison.
복불복 회전 포인터 피구 — 손가락 화살표 술래 지목 & 콘 위 탱탱볼 추격
회전 포인터(또는 빈 페트병), 탱탱볼(소프트볼) 1개, 공 받침용 접시콘 1개
Spin-Pointer Roulette Dodgeball — Instant Tagger Sprint to the Tee-Ball

Players gather around a spinning finger pointer on the floor while a bouncy foam ball sits on a cone a few meters away. Whoever the pointer lands on sprints to grab the ball from the cone while everyone else scatters. Vary rounds between hand-throwing, foot-kicking, and moving the ball's cone into the escape path.
Spinning pointer (or plastic bottle), 1 bouncy foam ball, 1 disc cone
말랑공 패스 전용 변형 얼티밋 프리즈비 게임

1) Mark a rectangular court with 2m endzones at both ends using 8 cones; two teams line up on their start lines.
2) The team losing Rock-Paper-Scissors throws the soft ball deep to the opposing team to start.
3) Players cannot run or dribble with the ball and must pass within 5 seconds; catching a pass inside the opponent's endzone scores 1 point.
4) Any incomplete pass, deflection, interception, or out-of-bounds turnovers possession immediately, and teams swap endzones after each score.
양측 후프 감옥 구출식 상대 엔드라인 콘 뺏기 진놀이

1) Divide a rectangular court in half; place 6 cones on spot markers along each endline and 2 hula-hoop prisons in the middle of each half.
2) Players invade the opponent's half to grab 1 endline cone and carry it back outside the sideline to place between cones on their own endline.
3) Players tagged in enemy territory go to either of the 2 hula-hoop prisons; a teammate's tag frees everyone in that hoop.
4) Freed players and cone-carriers wave both hands ('twinkle hands') for safe passage home; the team with more cones when time expires wins.
12 cones, 12 spot markers, 4 hula hoops, team pinnies
이름 쪽지 타깃 추적 및 원마커 방빼기 '추격자' 술래잡기
원마커(인원수의 2/3), 라바콘 4개, 학생 이름 쪽지, 바구니
Secret Name-Slip Target Chase & Spot-Eviction Tag ('The Chaser')

1) Place 4 corner cones around the court and scatter spot markers (2/3 of class size) inside as 1-person safe zones; each student draws a secret name slip.
2) Chase and tag the target on your slip, reveal the slip, and play full-body Rock-Paper-Scissors; players on a spot marker are safe until someone calls 'Vacate!' to take the spot.
3) If the chaser wins RPS, the target is out, hands over their name slip, and removes 1 spot marker to sit on outside while the chaser hunts the new target.
4) If the runner wins RPS, the chaser must touch one of the 4 outer cones before resuming; the game ends when all spot markers are removed.
Spot markers (2/3 of class size), 4 cones, name slips, basket
W·M자 라바콘 지그재그 달리기 기록 단축 및 모둠 추격 릴레이
W-M Cone Zigzag Agility Time-Trial & Pursuit Relay

1) Arrange 10 cones in a W/M zigzag pattern with 2 waiting spot markers set safely behind opposite starting cones.
2) Stage 1 (Solo Time Trial): start seated with left fingers touching the start cone, weave left and right around all cones, and return to touch the start cone to beat your personal time.
3) Stage 2 (Team Pursuit Relay): two 4-player teams start at opposite ends and run full zigzag laps, tagging the next teammate.
4) Waiting runners stay on the back spot marker until the opposing runner passes; the first team to finish 12 laps (3 per runner) or overtake the opponent wins.
10 cones, 2 spot markers, team pinnies, stopwatch
5x5 접시콘 보물 수거형 플라잉디스크 보물 야구

1) Arrange 25 disc cones in a 5×5 grid in the field and set separate offensive and defensive home bases on the right and left.
2) Play 9v9 all-batter innings; the batter throws a flying disc into fair territory, grabs 1 or more disc cones from the grid, and runs to offensive home base.
3) Fielders score an out by catching the disc in the air or relaying/running a grounded disc to defensive home base before the runner returns.
4) Safe runners score 1 point per cone retrieved (cones are returned if out); play 2 innings and total the points.
Flying disc, 25 disc cones, 2 home bases, field liner
교실 바닥 슬라이딩 고리 원형 피구 (타임레이스·점수제)

1) Sit in a large circle on the classroom floor; attackers sit around the outside with 1–2 plastic rings while dodgers stand inside.
2) Attackers slide the rings flat across the floor without lifting them; dodgers jump or sidestep so the ring does not touch their feet.
3) Mode 1 (Group Time Trial): each small group enters the circle and times how long they survive up to 1 minute.
4) Mode 2 (Two-Team Point Battle): play 2-minute halves with 2 rings; hit dodgers step out, do 5 squats, add 1 point to the opponent's scoreboard, and re-enter.
머리 위·다리 사이 공 이어주고 맨 뒤로 달리는 '애지중지 공 모시기'
Pass-and-Sprint-Ahead Cooperative Ball Relay ('Precious Ball Escort')

1) Form teams of 4–6 in a single file with backs to the direction of travel; Player 1 holds a ball.
2) On the signal, pass the ball backward overhead (or between legs/sideways) to the next teammate.
3) As soon as a player passes the ball, they sprint to the end of the line toward the turning cone to receive the ball again.
4) Teams continuously pass and sprint around the turning cone and back to the start line; first team across wins.
1 ball per team, turning cones, team pinnies
외곽 패스 연결 및 내부 공격수 터치 아웃 '찜피구 ver 1.0'

1) Mark a square court; 4 attackers stand around the outside perimeter while 1–2 attackers and all defenders start inside the square.
2) Attackers cannot walk with the ball and must pass quickly between perimeter and inside teammates to corner defenders.
3) An attacker holding the ball scores an out by reaching out and touching ('tagging') a defender with the ball—throwing the ball at a defender does not count.
4) Compare total time to eliminate all defenders or count surviving defenders after a 3-minute round.
1 dodgeball or foam ball, cones, team pinnies
4대6 공수 역할 분담 양 팀 동시 추격 '변형 다방구'

1) Set 2 home bases (trees outdoors or hula hoops indoors) and divide into two 10-player teams, each split into 4 attackers (pinnie tied on arm) and 6 defenders (wearing pinnie).
2) Each team's 4 attackers chase the opponent's 6 defenders and escort tagged defenders to their own base prison.
3) Captured defenders cannot be rescued by their own attackers—only a surviving teammate defender can run in, slap the base, and shout 'Dabanggu!' to free everyone.
4) Play for 5 minutes; the team with more uncaptured defenders at the buzzer wins.
Team pinnies, 2 hula hoops (for indoor bases)
중앙 라인 교차 대기 및 등 터치 '코!' 교대 인도 전통 코코 술래잡기
원마커(인원 절반-1개), 라바콘 6개, 팀 조끼, 타이머, 점수판

1) Place spot markers one arm's length apart along the center line with 2 end cones 1m beyond the ends; chasers stand on the spots facing alternating directions.
2) Three runners enter the court at a time and may cross the center line freely, whereas the active chaser cannot cross the center line.
3) To pursue a runner on the other side, the chaser must either run around an end cone or tap the back of a teammate facing that side while shouting 'Kho!' to transfer the chaser role.
4) Tagged runners exit, add 1 point to the chasers' scoreboard, and tag in the next runner; play two 3-minute halves.
Spot markers, 6 cones, team pinnies, timer, scoreboard
터치 시 가위바위보 및 점핑잭 과제 수행 '보물 쟁탈전 진놀이'
Rock-Paper-Scissors & Jumping-Jack Treasure Raid Base Game

1) Divide a rectangular court in half and mark a treasure vault at each endline with 4 cones filled with equal beanbags.
2) Players sprint into enemy territory to grab 1 beanbag from the vault and return along the outside sideline to deposit it in their own vault.
3) If a defender tags an attacker before they touch a beanbag, both play Rock-Paper-Scissors; the winner immediately continues their action (taking treasure or defending).
4) An attacker who loses RPS steps off the court for 5 jumping jacks before returning to start, while a losing defender does 5 jumping jacks in place; most beanbags after 3 minutes wins.
20초 제한 시간 연속 교체 생존형 '순환 20초 술래잡기'

1) Mark a square court with cones and a start spot marker; half the class starts inside as runners while the other half lines up at the start spot as taggers.
2) The first tagger sprints into the court and has 20 seconds to tag any runner.
3) If the tagger tags a runner within 20 seconds, the tagger becomes a runner on the court, the tagged runner joins the back of the tagger line, and the next tagger enters immediately.
4) If 20 seconds expire without a tag, the whistle blows, that tagger returns to the back of the line, and the next tagger enters; runners inside at the 5-minute mark win.
반환점 타 모둠 수비수 대결 및 모둠 한 바퀴 돌아 손터치 릴레이
Turnaround RPS Defender Challenge & Loop-Behind-Line Tag Relay

1) Divide into teams of 6 with start and turnaround cones; each team sends 1 defender to stand at the turnaround cone of the team to their right.
2) Practice basic turnaround relays first, then practice looping all the way around the back of your team's line before tagging the next runner.
3) In the main game, each runner sprints to the turnaround cone and plays Rock-Paper-Scissors against the opposing defender stationed there.
4) Winners run straight back while losers do 3 jumping jacks before returning, looping behind their team line to tag the next runner.
밭 전(田) 자 4구역 조끼 패스 추격 '사각 협력 술래잡기'
팀 조끼(팀 구분용 + 터치용 2개), 라바콘 및 원마커, 점수판

1) Divide the court into a 2×2 grid of 4 squares using cones and spot markers; all runners start in 1 square while taggers divide equally into the 4 squares.
2) Taggers must stay inside their assigned square, while runners move between adjacent squares (diagonal movement is forbidden for both teams).
3) Only taggers holding one of the 2 'tag pinnies' may tag a runner; as runners flee to adjacent squares, taggers pass or toss the tag pinnies to teammates in those squares.
4) Tagged runners step out, add 1 point to the scoreboard, and re-enter any square; play two 3-minute halves.
Team pinnies plus 2 tag pinnies, cones and spot markers, scoreboard
3x3 뒤집힌 숫자카드 1~9 순서 기억 수집 '협력 숫자 릴레이'

1) Form teams of 4 at the start line; at the far end, another team shuffles and lays 9 number cards (1–9) face down in a 3×3 grid.
2) Runners take turns sprinting to flip 1 card; if it is not the next required number (starting from 1), they hold it overhead to show teammates before placing it back face down.
3) If the flipped card matches the next number in sequence, the runner brings it back to the team.
4) Teammates share memory clues to collect cards 1 through 9 in exact order; award 3, 2, and 1 points for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place across rounds.
Number card sets (1–9 per team), cones
손잡고 줄 늘렸다 줄이는 협력 추격 '고무줄 달리기 1탄(1대1 대결)'

1) Place 2 large cones in the center; two teams form human chains holding hands outward from their center cone (the innermost player touches the cone).
2) On the whistle, the outermost player on each team sprints counterclockwise around both human chains for one full lap.
3) When the opponent's runner rounds your team's chain, stretch your hand-chain out wide to make their path longer; when your own runner rounds your chain, shrink shoulder-to-shoulder.
4) The first runner to complete the lap and grab their outermost teammate's hand scores 1 point; if a team's hand-chain breaks at any time, the opponent automatically gets the point.
배웅줄·마중줄 타이밍 익히기 다 함께 8자 긴줄넘기

1) Select an age-appropriate long rope (4m for grades 1–2, 5m for grades 3–4, 6m for grades 5–6); two turners swing the rope while jumpers line up.
2) Learn entry timing: enter as the rope hits the floor on an 'away' swing, or as the rope rises upward on a 'toward' swing, jumping in the center.
3) Jumpers enter one after another on every turn, jump once, and exit diagonally to trace a continuous figure-8 path around the turners.
4) Compete for the most jumps during a set time (or one song) or race to reach a target jump count first.
Long jump rope (4–6m), music player or stopwatch
감옥 탈출 및 연행 중 탈주 변형 '경찰과 도둑' 추격 술래잡기
팀 조끼, 매트 또는 라바콘(실내 감옥 및 라인 표시용)
Cops and Robbers Tag with Prison Break & Escort Escape

1) Designate a prison area (goalpost outdoors or mat/circle indoors) and boundary lines; divide into Cops and Robbers wearing pinnies.
2) Robbers scatter before the start signal; Cops chase and tag Robbers to put them in prison (stepping out of bounds also counts as captured).
3) Any free Robber who breaks through and tags a jailed teammate frees all Robbers currently in prison.
4) In the advanced variation, a tagged Robber being escorted to prison may bolt and escape if the Cop's grip or attention loosens before reaching prison.
Team pinnies, mat or cones (for prison and boundaries)
2인 협동 양팔 껍질 벗기기 구출 '바나나 술래잡기'

1) Select taggers holding foam noodles while the rest of the class flees across the gym or field.
2) Before being tagged, a runner can shout 'Banana!' and clasp both hands high overhead to freeze safely in place.
3) To unfreeze a 'Banana', two free runners must come to opposite sides, gently lower the frozen player's left and right arms like peeling a banana, and shout 'One, two, three, unfreeze!'
4) Anyone tagged before calling Banana becomes the new tagger after a 5-second count; taggers win if all runners are frozen.
2인 손잡기 연결로 도망자 역할이 바뀌는 '고양이와 쥐' 술래잡기
Partner-Chain Hand-Hold Role-Swap 'Cat and Mouse' Tag

1) With 8 or more players, pick 1 Cat (tagger) and 1 Mouse (runner); all other players pair up holding hands scattered around the space.
2) On the signal, the Cat chases the Mouse around the standing pairs.
3) Whenever the Mouse grabs the free hand of a standing pair, the player on the other end of that pair immediately becomes the new Mouse and must flee.
4) The Cat switches targets to chase the new Mouse; if the Cat tags the Mouse, they swap roles and restart after a 5-second count.
중앙 출입금지 원형 표적 및 양 끝 다중 골대 '콘 축구'
축구공 1개, 라바콘 여러 개, 팀 조끼
Center No-Entry Circle & Multi-Goal 'Cone Target Soccer'

1) Stand several cones in the center of the court surrounded by a 5-step-radius circle that no player may enter.
2) Two teams in pinnies dribble and pass using feet only (no hands) to shoot at the cones inside the center circle.
3) Knocking down a center cone scores 1 point; reset the fallen cone immediately and continue play.
4) Variation: place 1 or 2 cone-goals at each end of a rectangular court (up to 4 total goals) and try to knock down the opponent's cones.
잡히면 제자리 촉수 수비수로 변하는 왕복 '말미잘 술래잡기'
Stationary Tentacle-Blocker Shuttle Tag ('Sea Anemone Tag')

1) Mark safe zones at both ends of a rectangular court; 1 tagger stands in the center while all runners line up in one safe zone.
2) When the tagger calls 'Start!', runners dash across to the opposite safe zone.
3) Anyone tagged along the way freezes on that exact spot as a 'Sea Anemone'—feet planted, waving both arms left and right to help tag remaining runners.
4) Surviving runners shuttle back and forth on each signal as more Sea Anemones fill the court until everyone is caught.
던지지 않고 패스로 접근해 팔 뻗어 태그하는 안전 '찜 피구'

1) Set a square or circular court; the attacking team stands around the outside with 1 attacker inside, while the defending team moves inside.
2) Attackers cannot walk while holding the ball and must pass among outside and inside teammates to close in on defenders.
3) Instead of throwing the ball, an attacker holding the ball stretches their arm to touch ('tag') a nearby defender with the ball for an out.
4) Variations: add a second ball or let tagged defenders flip the opponent's scoreboard by 1 point and immediately re-enter for a timed game.
1–2 foam dodgeballs, cones, team pinnies, scoreboard
1발~10발 점프 추격 및 술래 주문 미션 귀환 전래놀이 '한 발 뛰기'
없음(맨손, 출발선 표시용 콘 또는 분필)
1-to-10 Jump Handicap Chase & Command-Return Traditional Game ('One-Step Jump')

1) Mark a starting line; in Round 1, runners take 1 big jump forward and turn around while the tagger reaches from the line to tag anyone within reach, then runners must jump back across the line in 1 jump.
2) In Rounds 2 through 10, runners take N jumps out and must return in N jumps, while the tagger chases using (N−1) jumps (one jump fewer than the runners).
3) After Round 10, runners return to the start line following the tagger's creative command (one-foot hopping, duck walk, traffic-light signals, bouncing a shoe like a hot sweet potato, or blindfolded step-estimation).
4) Anyone tagged, failing the command, or falling short of the start line becomes the next tagger.
None (chalk or cones for the start line)
4칸 강 수비 구역 돌파 및 반환선 보물 왕복 운반 '강 건너기 놀이'
팀 조끼, 라바콘, 나무토막(또는 콩주머니·작은 공), 바구니 2개
4-River Defense Zone Breakthrough & Treasure Shuttle ('River Crossing')

1) Mark a rectangular court with 4 narrow 'River' defense zones (2 steps wide) alternating with 3 'Land' safe zones (4 steps wide), placing a basket of blocks/beanbags at the far turn line.
2) Defenders station themselves inside the River zones while attackers start at the home line.
3) Attackers dodge through all 4 Rivers to grab 1 block from the far line and cross back to drop it into the start basket for 1 point.
4) Tagged attackers raise both hands, walk out along the sideline to restart from the start or turn line; swap roles after 5 minutes.
Team pinnies, cones, wooden blocks or beanbags, 2 baskets
중앙선 앉은 추격자 어깨 터치 교대식 '코코 술래잡기'

1) Chasers sit two steps apart along the center line facing alternating sides while 1 active chaser starts at the end of the line.
2) Three runners enter the court at a time (as soon as 1 runner is tagged out, 1 waiting teammate enters to keep 3 active runners).
3) Runners may cross through the center line freely, whereas the active chaser cannot cross the center line and must tap a seated teammate's shoulder to switch chasers.
4) Time how long it takes to tag all runners out or play timed halves, then swap team roles.
5m·10m 거리별 득점 콘 선택 반환 '콘 돌아오기 발야구'

1) Place separate offensive and defensive home-base spot markers near the kicking plate, and set cones 5m (1 point) and 10m (2 points) away along the running line.
2) After kicking the ball, the kicker chooses whether to round the 5m cone or 10m cone and return to offensive home base.
3) Fielders retrieve the ball and pass or run it to step on defensive home base; if the runner returns first, they score 1 or 2 points accordingly.
4) Swap roles after all batters kick; play 3 innings and compare total scores.
1 soccer ball or volleyball, 2–4 cones, 2 spot markers
배드민턴 라켓(1인 1개), 110~120 BPM 음악 및 스피커

1) Hold 1 badminton racket per student and perform 5 progressive stroke-and-footwork missions to 110–120 BPM music using 4×8-count phrases.
2) Mission 1 (Stationary): practice wrist-snap forehand/backhand and underhand strokes in place on the beat.
3) Missions 2–4 (Stepping): perform One-Step lunge overhead/underhand strokes, Two-Step side-sliding strokes, and Back-Step overhead strokes.
4) Mission 5 (Hairpin Combo & Choreography): combine one-step and two-step net hairpin strokes, then let groups rearrange the 5 missions into a custom routine.
Badminton rackets (1 per student), 110–120 BPM music player
무릎 아래 바닥 굴리기 공격 및 팔벌려뛰기 부활 '원형 피구'

1) Draw a large circle; the attacking team sits around the outside line while the defending team stands inside.
2) Seated attackers roll a soft ball across the floor (no throwing allowed); hits above the knee do not count.
3) Any defender touched below the knee by a rolling ball is out, steps outside to do jumping jacks, and re-enters while adding 1 point to the attackers' tally.
4) Compare total outs scored in 2–5 minutes, or add a 2nd ball / slide rings or flying discs indoors.
1–2 soft foam balls (or rings/flying discs indoors)
1~6번 주사위공 호명 공격 및 손목밴드 뺏기 '주사위 피구(무지개 피구)'
Dice-Ball Number Call & Wristband-Stealing Dodgeball ('Rainbow Dodgeball')

1) Form groups of 6 numbered 1–6; each player wears 3 same-colored wristbands on their right wrist and stands in a circle.
2) Roll a large foam dice-ball into the center; the player whose number lands on top grabs the ball and shouts 'Freeze!' while the other 5 freeze in place.
3) The attacker takes at most 1 step and throws at a defender, who must dodge or catch without moving their feet.
4) A hit lets the attacker take 1 wristband from the defender, while a clean catch lets the defender take 1 wristband from the attacker; win by collecting the most bands or all 6 colors ('Rainbow Dodgeball').
1 large foam dice-ball, 6-color wristbands (3 per player)
공격수·수비수 1대2 편성 쌍방 진 구출 전래놀이 '팀전 다방구'

1) Set 2 base hoops and divide each team in a 1:2 ratio of Attackers (pinnie tied on arm) to Defenders (wearing pinnie).
2) Attackers chase and tag the opposing team's Defenders, sending tagged Defenders to stand inside the Attacker's base hoop.
3) Only free teammate Defenders (not Attackers) can sprint to the opponent's base, tag the prisoners, and shout 'Dabanggu!' to release them all.
4) After 5 minutes, the team with more free Defenders wins; for small groups, use 1 center base with 1 base-guard tagger and 1 chaser tagger.
어깨 높이 패스 3회 제한 및 캐치 시 공수 교대 '3인 피구'

1) On a small square or circle court, 2 players start outside as throwers and 1 player starts inside as the dodger.
2) The 2 outside throwers may pass the ball overhead (above shoulder height) up to 3 times maximum before attacking.
3) Any throw below shoulder height aimed at the inside player counts as an attack; the inside player faces the ball at all times to dodge or catch it.
4) Whenever the inside player is hit or catches an attack cleanly, they swap places with the thrower.
1 dodgeball per 3 players, court lines or cones
10m 페트병 표적·30m 대형 바구니·삼각 볼링 '디스크 슈팅'
플라잉디스크, 1~1.5L 빈 페트병 10개 이상, 대형 바구니, 라바콘

1) Set up 1.5L plastic bottle targets at 10m and a large basket at 30m in the gym or field.
2) Stage 1 (10m Target Knockdown): teams take turns throwing flying discs to knock down the most bottles (add obstacles in between to increase difficulty).
3) Stage 2 (30m Long-Range Basket): alternate throws at a large basket 30m away; first team to land a disc inside wins.
4) Stage 3 (10-Pin Disc Bowling): arrange 10 plastic bottles in a bowling triangle and compete to knock down the most pins.
Flying discs, 10+ plastic bottles (1–1.5L), large basket, cones
5단계 연속 기술 서바이벌 및 팀 이어달리기 '디스크 무한도전'
5-Stage Skill Survival & Team Relay 'Flying-Disc Infinite Challenge'

1) Each student holds a flying disc in an open space and attempts 5 consecutive skill challenges.
2) Stages 1–3: (1) balance the disc on your head while turning 360° → (2) spin the disc on one finger for 5 seconds → (3) toss the disc behind your back and catch it in front.
3) Stages 4–5: (4) toss the disc high, spin 360°, and catch it → (5) throw the disc into a basketball hoop.
4) Team Relay Variation: teams of 5 complete Stages 1 to 5 in relay order, restarting from Stage 1 if a teammate misses.
Flying discs (1 per student), basketball hoop or target
원바운드 허용 미니 코트 1대1·2대2 배구 '일대일 코트 플레이'

1) Set up a compact court (3 steps long by 6 steps wide on each side of a badminton or volleyball net) using disc cones.
2) 1v1 Singles: serve underhand from behind the endline; return the ball over the net in 1 touch (either on the fly or after 1 bounce) to play to 5 points.
3) 2v2 Doubles: blocking at the net is allowed, and both teammates must touch the ball (exactly 2 touches per side) before sending it over.
4) Cooperative Rally Mode: pairs work together across the net to achieve the highest consecutive rally count.
Soft volleyball or bouncy ball, badminton/volleyball net, disc cones
바닥 일자 라인 활용 8가지 리듬 스텝 콤비네이션 & 릴레이 '점핑 체조'
없음(바닥 일자 라인, 음악 재생용 휴대폰·스피커)

1) Use any straight floor line and upbeat music to learn 8 rhythm jump steps in 8-count sets.
2) Steps 1–4: (1) alternating running jumps → (2) 4× right/left one-foot hops → (3) straddle jumps over the line → (4) side-to-side zigzag line jumps.
3) Steps 5–8: (5) squat-and-jump straddles → (6) two hops + cross-line squat jump → (7) 180° turn straddle jumps → (8) mid-air heel-clap jumps.
4) Compete in 3-player endurance survival (continuous 8-step combos) or 4-player shuttle relays advancing along a floor line while performing all 8 steps.
외곽 트랙 한 바퀴 달린 후 중앙 후프에 공 굴려 넣는 '달려-굴려-넣어! 볼링'
공(인원수만큼), 훌라후프 1개, 원마커, 접시콘, 번호 조끼

1) Place 1 target hula hoop in the center, surrounded by individual spot markers and an outer running track marked with cones.
2) On 'Go!', players holding a ball sprint one full lap around the outer cone track.
3) Upon returning to step on their spot marker, players roll their ball toward the center hula hoop.
4) Award 40, 30, 20, and 10 points in the order balls stop inside the hoop; players who miss retrieve their ball and keep rolling from their spot until everyone scores.
Balls, 1 hula hoop, spot markers, disc cones, numbered pinnies
4방향 홈베이스 고깔콘 3개 먼저 모으기 민첩성 '싹쓰리 콘 게임!'

1) Set 4 home spot markers in a square with 1 cone on each home base and 2 extra cones in the center (6 cones total).
2) Four players start at their home bases; on 'Go!', everyone sprints to grab 1 cone at a time from the center or from any opponent's home base.
3) Players may carry only 1 cone at a time and cannot block or guard their own home cones.
4) The first player to gather 3 cones simultaneously at their own home base wins the round.
공으로 풍선 치고 옆 친구에게 공 건네기 모둠 협응 '살리고 건네고!'
Hit-the-Balloon-With-the-Ball & Hand-Off Circle Challenge ('Keep It Up & Pass')

1) Groups of 5–6 stand in a small circle with 1 ball and 1 inflated balloon per group.
2) Player 1 taps the balloon straight up using the ball they are holding ('Keep it up!'), then immediately hands the ball to the neighbor on their side ('Pass!').
3) The next player takes the ball, taps the falling balloon straight up with the center of the ball, and hands the ball to the next teammate.
4) Continue around the circle without letting the balloon touch the floor until reaching the target count (e.g., 10 or 20 hits).
7 Creative Rock-Paper-Scissors Variations (Hand, Foot, Full-Body, Jumping-Jack & 180-Turn)

1) Pair up to practice 7 active Rock-Paper-Scissors (RPS) variations for warm-ups and fair game officiating.
2) Variations 1–3 (Hand): (1) Palm-top RPS → (2) High-five clap RPS → (3) Double-hand RPS.
3) Variations 4–6 (Foot & Full-Body): (4) Foot RPS (feet together=rock, front-back stride=scissors, wide straddle=paper) → (5) Full-body pose RPS → (6) Jumping-Jack RPS (arms crossed overhead=scissors, together=rock, wide=paper).
4) Variation 7 (1-2-3-4 Turnaround RPS): stand back-to-back, jump 3 times on '1, 2, 3', and spin 180° in the air on '4' to land in your RPS pose.
1점 안쪽 코스·2점 바깥쪽 코스 선택형 '도전, 던지기 야구 게임!'
1-Point Inner Track vs 2-Point Outer Track Choice 'Challenge Throw-Baseball'

1) Set up two concentric base diamonds—an inner blue diamond and an outer pink diamond—plus separate offensive and defensive home bases.
2) Before throwing the ball into the field, the batter calls out either '1 Point!' or '2 Points!'
3) On a '1 Point' call, the batter runs the shorter inner blue bases while fielders must relay the ball around the wider outer pink bases to defensive home.
4) On a '2 Points' call, the batter must run the longer outer pink bases while fielders step onto the shorter inner blue bases to relay the ball home.
1 soft ball, 8 two-color base markers (inner/outer), 2 home bases
후프 바닥에 끌며 달리고 잡히면 후프 10회 돌려 부활하는 '후질끄 술래'

1) Every student—including 1–2 taggers holding foam sticks—stands inside a large hula hoop.
2) All players must move by holding the back of their hoop while dragging the front edge along the floor (lifting the whole hoop off the floor is a foul).
3) Taggers also drag their hoops while chasing runners to tap them below the shoulder with a foam stick.
4) Tagged runners stay on the court, spin their hula hoop 10 times around their waist, arm, or neck, and immediately rejoin the chase.
Large hula hoops (1 per student), 1–2 foam noodles
대형 공 노바운드 패스 및 토스 후 스파이크 슛 '파센볼(Fassenball) 변형 게임'
빅발리볼(또는 미니 킨볼·경량 짐볼) 1개, 골대 2개, 팀 조끼
Giant-Ball Air-Pass & Toss-to-Spike Goal Game ('Modified Fassenball')

1) Two teams play on a gym court with goals at each end using a large lightweight ball (big volleyball, mini Kin-Ball, or light gym ball).
2) Players cannot walk while holding the ball and must advance it via air passes without letting the ball touch the floor.
3) Goals cannot be scored by throwing—a teammate near the goal must toss/set the ball into the air and another teammate must spike/hit it into the goal.
4) If the ball touches the floor, possession changes; defenders may intercept passes but are penalized for pressing down on a held ball.
1 large lightweight ball (big volleyball/mini Kin-Ball), 2 goals, team pinnies
빈백 던져 안착시키고 후프 수거해 손에서 손으로 전달하는 '후프 따먹기'
Beanbag Target Toss & Hand-to-Hand Hoop Collection Relay ('Hoop Capture')

1) Lay 8 flat hoops at various distances in front of each team's start line; players hold beanbags in a relay line.
2) Player 1 tosses a beanbag toward a target hoop and runs out; if the beanbag lands completely inside the hoop, they pick up both the beanbag and the hoop.
3) If the beanbag misses or touches the hoop rim (for upper grades), the runner retrieves only the beanbag.
4) Returning runners must hand the beanbag and captured hoop directly hand-to-hand to the next teammate (no throwing) to stack behind the line until all hoops are captured.
Beanbags, flat hula hoops (about 8 per team)
굴러가는 후프가 쓰러지기 전에 달려가 고깔콘 씌우기 '후프 안으로 콘을 쏙!'
Rolling-Hoop Timing Sprint & Cone Drop ('Cone Into the Rolling Hoop!')

1) Form groups of 2 or 3 with 1 hula hoop and 1 cone per player.
2) One player rolls the hula hoop forward across the floor while the other 1–2 players sprint alongside holding their cones.
3) Right before the wobbling hoop falls flat onto the floor, players must drop their cone cleanly inside the center of the hoop.
4) Dropping the cone after the hoop is already flat on the floor does not count; the first player to land their cone inside before it falls scores 1 point, and roles rotate.
1 hula hoop per group, 1 cone per student
가위바위보 승리 시 콘·점보스택스 운반해 골대 세우기 준비운동 게임

1) Use this warm-up right before a main ball game; teams race to collect cones or jumbo stacking cups from the far side to build their goalposts.
2) Players sprint to meet opponents and play Rock-Paper-Scissors; the winner takes 1 cone or jumbo cup back to assemble their team's goal tower.
3) The loser performs 2 quick squats on the spot and immediately jumps back into the next RPS duel.
4) The first team to finish building their goal structure wins the warm-up, and the completed towers serve directly as the goals for the main game.
플랭크(팔굽혀펴기) 자세로 빈백 밀어 골 넣는 '플랭크 빈백 슬라이딩 하키'
스포츠 빈백(콩주머니) 1개, 골대 표시용 컵(또는 콘) 4개
Push-Up Position 1v1 Core Game ('Plank Beanbag Sliding Hockey')

1) Two players face each other in a push-up (plank) position on a smooth gym or classroom floor, with 2 cups/cones flanking each player to mark goal width.
2) Maintaining a plank, players use one flat palm to slide a beanbag across the floor toward the opponent's goal.
3) Sliding the beanbag past the opponent between their outer cups scores 1 point; sliding it right between the opponent's hands and feet (under their body) scores 3 points!
4) Players block and shoot one-handed while holding the plank with the other arm(allow knee-plank modification as needed).
1 beanbag per pair, 4 cups or cones
주사위 피구공 홀짝 공격권 및 빠른 걸음 추격 '홀짝 워킹 피구'
주사위 피구공(폼 주사위) 1개, 라인 표시용 원마커
Odd-Even Dice Roll & Fast-Walk-Only Chase ('Odd-Even Walking Dodgeball')

1) Divide into an Odd Team (1, 3, 5) and an Even Team (2, 4, 6), with safe home lines at opposite ends of the room.
2) Roll a foam dice-ball in the center; if an odd number lands up, the Odd Team attacks while the Even Team flees to their home line (and vice versa).
3) Running is strictly forbidden—all players must move by fast walking only as attackers pass the dice-ball and try to hit defenders before they cross their safe line.
4) Score 1 point per hit (or have hit players perform the fitness task on the die), then return to the center for the next roll.
1 foam dice-ball, spot markers for safe lines
V싯 복근 자세로 발목 위 공 집어 연속 패스하는 2인 1조 '윗몸 공 저글링'
Partner V-Sit Ankle-to-Hand Continuous Pass ('Sit-Up Ball Juggling')

1) Pair up with 2 soft balls; Partner A sits on the floor leaning back in an engaged V-sit core posture holding 1 ball, while Partner B stands at their feet holding the 2nd ball.
2) Partner B places their ball on top of Partner A's ankles/shins.
3) Partner A chest-passes the ball in their hands to Partner B, then immediately reaches forward to grab the ball resting on their ankles and passes it next.
4) Partner B catches each pass and quickly places it back on Partner A's ankles in a continuous juggling rhythm for 10–15 reps before switching roles.
주사위 피구공 홀짝·숫자 동시 예언 및 체력 미션 '예언해봐! 홀짝 게임'
Odd/Even & Exact-Number Prediction Fitness Dice Game ('Predict It! Odd or Even')

1) Pairs or small groups gather around a foam fitness dice-ball (printed with numbers 1–6 and exercises) and a scoreboard.
2) Before each roll, every player/team predicts both 'Odd or Even' AND one specific number from 1 to 6.
3) Guessing Odd/Even correctly earns 1 point, while nailing the exact number earns 3 points; anyone whose prediction misses performs the fitness exercise shown on the top face.
4) First player or team to reach 15 points wins.
여러 가지 기본 움직임 스텝 표현하기
특별한 준비물 없이 맨손으로 활동 가능합니다.

1) Spread out with enough space between classmates and travel around the area using basic locomotor movements such as walking, jumping, and hopping.
2) Learn skipping (alternating a walk and a hop with rhythm) and galloping (one foot leads while the other follows, like a horse).
3) Learn leaping (spring from one foot and land on the other as if crossing stepping stones) and sliding (glide along the floor sweeping the soles of the feet).
4) Link the movements you have learned and travel freely around the space, expressing them.
No equipment needed; can be done bare-handed.
스캐터볼 주사위 공, 6색 손목 팔찌, 팀조끼

1) Players hold hands, circle around, and chant together.
2) The player whose turn it is throws the dice ball to the center; the player whose number is on top grabs it quickly and shouts 'Scatter!', and everyone running away freezes on the spot.
3) The catcher throws at another player; a hit wins that player's bracelet, but if the target catches the ball, the thrower must hand over a bracelet.
4) The first player to collect bracelets of every color wins.
Scatterball dice ball, wristbands in 6 colors, team pinnies
패드민턴 라켓, 셔틀콕, 네트, 팀조끼, 점수판

1) A game combining table tennis and badminton; split into two teams facing each other across a net.
2) Serve diagonally into the opponent's court, serving from the right side when your score is even and from the left when it is odd.
3) Hit the shuttlecock without letting it bounce and send it into an open space on the opponent's court to score.
4) Play three sets of 25 points each; the first team to win two sets wins the match.
Padminton rackets, shuttlecocks, net, team pinnies, scoreboard

1) A golf-style activity in which players throw flying discs from the tee toward a target called a discatcher.
2) After the first tee throw, the player farthest from the hole (discatcher) throws next, and so on in turn.
3) Place a spot marker where each disc lands; stepping on or over the marker while throwing costs a 1-stroke penalty.
4) After all holes are finished, the player or team with the fewest total throws wins.
Flying discs, discatcher, spot markers, team pinnies
플로어볼 스틱, 플로어볼 공, 골대, 팀조끼, 점수판

1) Form teams including a goalkeeper and start the match at the center face-off spot on the referee's signal.
2) Pass or dribble the ball with your stick and shoot into the opponent's goal to score.
3) Lifting the stick above waist height when attacking or shooting is called a foul.
4) Play two 10-minute halves; the team that scores more goals wins.
Floorball sticks, floorball balls, goals, team pinnies, scoreboard
스페이스볼(츄크볼 공), 츄크볼 전용 네트, 팀조끼, 점수판

1) A handball-style game in which a team passes up to 3 times and then shoots at a rebound net.
2) Defenders may not block passes or movement with their bodies or intercept the ball; they defend only by catching the rebounded ball.
3) If the ball bounces off the net and lands outside the forbidden zone without a defender catching it, the attackers score; if it lands inside the forbidden zone or goes out of bounds, the opponents score.
4) Play three 10-minute sets; the team with the higher total score wins.
Space ball (tchoukball), tchoukball rebound net, team pinnies, scoreboard
Around the World Through Dance, Part 3: Hawaiian Hula

1) Begin the expressive activity by learning the basic moves of the Hawaiian folk dance, hula, step by step.
2) The first move pushes the hips side to side with rhythm; the second draws rolling waves with the hands while gliding smoothly left and right.
3) The third move stretches the heel forward to show surprise at discovering a sea turtle; the last move links picking a star and holding it to the chest with a greeting.
4) Connect the moves you have learned and complete the whole routine to the music.
성장기 학생을 위한 키커지는 놀밥홈트 5강 (심폐지구력 편)
Height-Growing Play Home Training, Lesson 5 (Cardiovascular Endurance)

1) A home workout for growing students to build cardiovascular endurance and physical development; begin by jogging lightly in place to the beat of the music as a warm-up.
2) Perform full-body aerobic moves such as jumping jacks, arm walking, and high knees in order.
3) Follow the teacher's demonstration and count, and keep moving without rest for the set number of sets.
4) Finish with stretching to settle your breathing and relax the whole body.
Around the World Through Dance, Part 5: Russian Polka

1) Learn the five main moves of the traditional Russian folk dance, the polka, one by one, starting with a step that alternately taps the heel and the toe to the rhythm.
2) Add a turning move: jump on the left foot and spin once in place.
3) Practice drawing a mountain with the hands while squatting and then rising with arms wide, and the 'Tetris' pose with arms crossed and legs kicked out forward.
4) Link all the moves together and perform the whole routine to lively music.
Seated Balloon Volleyball in the Classroom

1) Push the desks against the walls, set up a net with box tape across the middle of the classroom, and split into two teams; everyone sits on the floor and may not lift their bottom or move from their chosen spot.
2) Start with a serve and, as in volleyball, hit the balloon within 3 touches to send it to the opponents' side.
3) If the balloon touches the floor, ceiling, desks, or walls, or hits the net, the other team scores; one player touching it twice in a row or the balloon passing under the net also loses the point.
4) The first team to reach 5 points wins.
Blindfolded Zombie Tag in the Classroom

1) The zombie (tagger) is blindfolded with a scarf or eye mask and searches for classmates using only touch and hearing.
2) Runners hide silently under desks or around chairs during the time limit, while the teacher gives verbal hints about the room layout and positions so the zombie can search safely.
3) A runner who is touched by the zombie or gives themselves away by making noise becomes the next zombie.
4) As a variation, runners can move silently to avoid the zombie instead of staying frozen in their hiding spot.
Flying Disc Ultimate: Basics and Practice

1) Learn to throw the disc with backhand, forehand, and hammer grips, and to catch it safely with pancake, overhead, and underhand catches.
2) Set up cones and practice space passes timed to the direction and speed of a teammate running into open space away from defenders, and learn the cut-in move of faking and then changing direction quickly.
3) Progress step by step by combining return passes with forward-space passes, or by advancing with continuous passes between points.
4) In the real game, keep passing and score by catching the disc in the opponent's end zone.
