4) If the attacker wins, they take 1 jumbo cup back to stack beside their own castle; if they lose, they return and high-five the next attacker.

1) Take a ready stance to throw the flying disc.
2) Step forward with an approach step to put power into the throw.
3) Maintain a horizontal angle and adjust height to throw as far as possible.
플라잉디스크 패스 및 피벗 기술 익히기
Flying Disc Passing and Pivot Drills

1) Practice 1-on-1 backhand passes with a partner, advancing to using 2 discs simultaneously.
2) Form a triangle of 3 players to circulate passes, then progress to using 2 discs.
3) Lead a sprinting teammate by passing into the open space ahead for a running catch.
4) When guarded, pivot on one foot while switching between backhand and forehand grips to bypass the defender safely.

1) Set up disc catchers on the schoolyard as holes and designate teeing areas with large cones.
2) Form groups such as 4 players per squad and take turns throwing discs toward the target disc catcher.
3) The player whose disc is farthest from the target throws next.
4) Record the total number of throws on the score sheet until the disc lands inside the disc catcher.
3 disc catchers, cones, score sheets, flying discs
컬 볼 보드판, 바둑알(또는 병뚜껑), 아이템 카드

1) Make a Curl-Ball board and form a team of 3 players.
2) Each player shoots 3 stones one by one, giving each team a total of 9 chances.
3) On each turn, players can hit or push out stones on the board, and landing in the item zone grants an item card to use.
4) Add up points from the point zones where stones remain, and the team with the highest score wins.
Curl-Ball board, baduk stones (or bottle caps), item cards

1) Lie down with a partner and perform shoulder and thoracic rotation stretches 6 reps on each side.
2) Lie prone to do gentle torso twists (6 reps) and superman back extensions.
3) Perform knee push-ups (10 reps x 2 sets) and glute bridges (6 reps x 2 sets).
4) Perform side-lying adductor hip lifts (6 reps each side x 2 sets).

1) Divide all players into groups of 4, decide the running order, and wait at the starting point.
2) On the starting signal, the first runner sprints to flip 1 cone, returns, and tags the next runner.
3) Continue the relay until all cones are flipped.
4) The team whose final runner flips the last cone and crosses the finish line first wins.

1) Divide players into two teams and arrange each team in pairs seated in a straight line toward the turning point.
2) Partners sit facing each other with soles touching, and the player closest to the starting line holds the handball.
3) On signal, pass the ball to the facing runner of the next pair, then quickly stand up with your partner and run to the back of the line.
4) The receiver passes short to their partner, who then passes long to the next pair; repeat this cycle, and the first team to round the cone and return wins.

1) Divide into groups of 5 and stand in a circle.
2) On the start signal, pass the ball to the right.
3) Before passing or receiving, students must wrap the ball around their torso in a full circle before throwing it.
4) The person holding the ball when the time limit (30 seconds) expires receives a penalty.

1) Divide into groups of 4 and have one person stand at each corner of a square.
2) One player spins a hula hoop upright in the center of the square, returns to position, and starts passing clockwise.
3) The team must complete a designated number of passes (30) before the hula hoop stops spinning.
4) Continue until successful; the team that finishes last receives a penalty.

1) Divide players into groups of 4 to 8 and distribute them evenly at each corner of a square.
2) On the start signal, pass the ball clockwise and move in the direction of the pass.
3) The team that finishes 30 passes first wins.
4) Vary the activity by changing the type of pass and direction.

1) Four participants each choose a hula hoop (house) and stand next to their ring.
2) On the start signal, take cones from other players' rings and bring them to your house.
3) Only one cone can be moved at a time, and carrying cones is not allowed except when moving one to your house.
4) When the time limit (30 seconds) ends, the person with the most cones in their ring wins.

1) Divide participants into groups of 4 to 6, selecting 1 tagger and 1 king.
2) All players except the tagger hold hands to form a circle and move together.
3) The tagger must touch the king from outside the circle, while teammates protect the king with their bodies.
4) Teammates must not let go of each other's hands, and roles are rotated.

1) All participants prepare outside the cones placed around the center line.
2) On the start signal, run to the right.
3) When the instructor's whistle sounds once, change running direction.
4) When the whistle sounds twice, quickly grab a cone in front; the player who fails to grab a cone is eliminated, one cone is removed, and continue until the final winner remains.

1) Divide participants into groups of 3; A and B each hold a ball while C stands opposite ready to receive.
2) A rolls a ball firmly on the floor to C, who catches it with one hand and throws it back to A.
3) Simultaneously, B rolls a ball, and C catches it with one hand and throws it back to B.
4) Once 10 passes are completed, players rotate clockwise to switch roles; the first team where all members complete 10 passes wins.
Handball Goalkeeper Forward Jump Save Drills

1) From a forward-moving stance, jump with both feet and spread arms and legs as wide as possible to narrow the shooting angle against open shots.
2) Take one step forward from a standing position and jump off one foot, spreading arms and legs wide to block.
3) Take two steps forward to meet the shooter's timing, extending arms and legs fully to make the save.

1) Place an exercise mat on the floor and secure a safe workout space.
2) Learn proper form for the Burpee Test combining squat, plank, and jump while protecting the lower back.
3) Perform Mountain Climbers by holding a steady plank posture and driving knees alternately toward the chest.
4) Execute Jumping Jacks by rhythmically jumping while spreading and clapping arms overhead and legs outward.

1) Spread two-colored square cards across the floor.
2) Play rock-paper-scissors to determine each team's designated card color.
3) On the whistle, players run in and flip cards to show their team's color for 30 seconds.
4) Hands off the cards immediately upon the ending whistle, progressing through 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 rounds until all members have participated.

1) [Stage 1 - Individual Pass] Each runner runs forward, lifts 2 hula hoops lying on the floor over their body one by one, runs back, and tags the next runner.
2) [Stage 2 - Pairs Pass] Pairs hold hands firmly and step through 2 hula hoops on the floor without letting go of their hands.
3) [Stage 3 - Group Pass] The entire group holds hands in a chain and moves the hula hoop along the line using only body movements without using hands.
4) The group that successfully moves the hula hoop to the final person without breaking hands wins the challenge.

1) Divide into two teams at the starting line and place a cone at the turning point for each team.
2) The first runner of each team places a balloon between their knees or thighs and gets ready.
3) On the start signal, hop forward with both feet without dropping the balloon, circle around the cone, and return.
4) Hand the balloon to the next teammate at the starting line; the team whose members all finish first wins.
Sport Stacking: Cycle Stacking Mirror Version

1) Begin with 3-6-3 stacking by up-stacking and down-stacking.
2) Continue with 6-6 stacking by up-stacking and down-stacking.
3) Finish by completing 1-10-1 stacking and down-stacking back into the initial 3-6-3 formation.

1) Divide into a kicking (batting) team and a fielding (pitching) team, and set up 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and home bases.
2) The pitcher rolls the ball along the ground inside the guide line toward home; three strikes result in an out, while three balls grant a walk to 1st base.
3) The kicker kicks the rolling ball into fair territory and immediately runs toward 1st base.
4) If the runner touches the base before the fielded ball arrives, they are safe; if the ball arrives first or a fly ball is caught, the runner is out, and touching home scores 1 point.

1) Divide into three teams of four (Pink, Grey, Black) within a 20m x 20m court.
2) Three players hold the ball while the hitter shouts 'Omnikin + defending team color' before hitting it above the waist.
3) The designated defending team must catch the ball before it touches the ground; after the third touch, players may only pivot.
4) If defense fails or a foul occurs, the other two teams each score 1 point simultaneously.
Kin-Ball (1.2m diameter), Team vests (3 colors), Scoreboard, Timer

1) Watch the leader perform movements while the first guitar part plays.

1) Sit comfortably on a chair and relax both body and mind.

1) Overhand throw: Turn the hips back, point toward the target, and rotate the hips leading with the elbow to throw forcefully overhead.
 2) Sidearm throw: Turn the body and release the ball sideways, controlling left/right direction with release timing.

 4) The team that clears all 10 cones first or accumulates the highest score wins.

1) Build a castle with Kapla blocks featuring walls and a central target.
 2) Build and shoot a Kapla cannon toward the target.
 3) Players attack each other's castles simultaneously, and the first to knock down the opponent's castle wins.

1) Taggers hold foam noodles to link together side-by-side like a fishing net.
 2) On signal, the net tags runners by chasing and cornering them.
 3) Runners tagged by the net must take a foam stick and attach to either end of the net.
 4) Once the net reaches its maximum set size, any additional players tagged are eliminated.
피구공 여러 개, 안전지대용 뜀틀/매트, 원마커, 팀 조끼

1) Set up 3-4 safe zones using mats or vaulting boxes and create an attacking zone in the middle.
 2) On the move command, runners must dash to another safe zone within 5 seconds.
 3) Attackers stationed in the center throw dodgeballs at the runners moving between zones.
 4) Players hit by a ball or failing to arrive within 5 seconds are out; the team with more survivors after a full cycle wins.
Dodgeballs, mats/vaulting boxes, spot markers, team pinnies
발바닥 그림 종이, 점수판, 타이머, 테이프

1) Draw footprints on drawing paper and arrange them irregularly on the floor to make a course.
 2) Determine the turn order for jumping along the footprints.
 3) Jump according to the footstep patterns in sequence to reach the finish.
 4) If a mistake is made, freeze for 3 seconds before resuming; the fastest player/team to finish wins.
Footprint drawings on paper, scoreboard, timer, tape

1) Set up cones on the opposite side of the court.
 2) Hit an underhand serve over the net.
 3) If a cone is hit and knocked down, retrieve and collect that cone.
 4) Take turns serving until all cones are knocked down; the team with the most cones wins.

1) Build a castle using jumbo cups or cones.
 2) Divide into teams and set the order for dribbling.
 3) Dribble the ball and knock down the opposing team's castle with a shot.
 4) Rebuild the castle after knocking it down and return to the starting line.
 5) The first person to return wins and earns points.
Jumbo cups or cones, soccer ball, scoreboard

1) Player 1 holds a fan, approaches Player 2, and challenges them to rock-paper-scissors.
 2) Roll a die, and the loser fans the winner with utmost care for the number of times shown (e.g., 6 times for 6, twice for 2).
 3) Proceed in order to Player 3 and Player 4 to play rock-paper-scissors and fan them in the same way.
 4) The next player then takes the fan and visits all classmates sequentially to complete the mission.
축구공, 백업 스틱(펀스틱), 골대, 팀 조끼

1) Designate a tagger defender for each team and hand them a foam stick.
 2) The defender cannot cross the centerline and must defend by tagging attacking opponents with the foam stick.
 3) Tagged attackers must run back and touch their own goalpost before rejoining play.
 4) Once a defender tags an opponent, they pass the foam stick to the nearest teammate to switch defender roles.
Soccer ball, foam noodles, goals, team pinnies

1) Kick the shuttlecock as many times as you can.
 2) After the kick, a teammate catches it with a basket.
 3) If caught, the team scores points (kicking twice and catching earns 2 points).

1) Divide players into offense and defense teams.
 2) The defensive team stacks a 3- to 5-level tower using blocks inside the marked area.
 3) The offensive team throws a foam die to knock down the tower within 5 attempts.
 4) Once knocked down, the offense retrieves the die to tag defenders while the original builder rebuilds the tower.

1) Two players lie down side by side facing opposite directions on a mat with hips aligned.
 2) On the count of "One, Two," each raises and lowers their leg once.
 3) On the count of "Three," hook legs together and attempt to flip or pin the opponent.
 4) Flipping the opponent results in an immediate win; if tied, hold for 5 seconds and whoever presses the opponent's leg down longer wins.

1) Prepare an inflated zip-lock bag and a basket to use as a hoop.
 2) Take turns practicing shooting the zip-lock bag into the basket.
 3) Pass the bag consecutively from the back and let the last player shoot into the basket.
 4) The last shooter gets as many shots as the number of bags received, aiming to score 10 points within the time limit.

1) Place cones worth 1 to 5 points according to distance.
 2) On start, run, choose which cone to round, and return.
 3) The person who crosses back first earns points equal to the distance of the rounded cone.

1) Place cups on a desk while two players hold both ends of string to create a track for a table tennis ball.
 2) Roll the ball on the string and pull strings apart to drop it into a cup.
 3) Earn 1 point for every ball successfully dropped into a cup; the team with more points wins.
Thick string, table tennis ball, cups

1) Place a disc cone on your head and get ready at the starting line.
 2) Move toward the target point while keeping the cone balanced on your head.
 3) If the cone falls during the run, return to the very end of the line.
 4) The next runner departs once high-fived by the returning runner.

1) One player from each team places a cone on their head and waits for the signal.
 2) On signal, throw the cone toward the central scoring cone.
 3) Points are awarded in the order cones are stacked onto the target.
 4) The next players take turns, and the team with the highest total score wins.

1) Draw a looping track on the classroom floor using chalk or masking tape.
 2) Take turns flicking markers (such as pebbles) along the track with fingers.
 3) The next teammate continues from where the marker stopped; if it goes off the track, it must restart from the beginning.
 4) The team that reaches the final space first or advances the furthest within the time limit wins.
pebbles, chalk or masking tape, scoreboard
Rolling on Mat Beanbag Transfer Relay

1) Place baskets on both sides of the mat and fill one basket with beanbags.
 2) A runner holds 1 beanbag and rolls sideways across the mat to the opposite basket.
 3) Place the beanbag into the basket and roll back to the starting point.
 4) Tag the next runner upon returning; the team that transfers more beanbags within the time limit wins.
오리 모양 풍선, 사냥용 풍선, 바닥 표시 테이프

1) Mark a boundary line on the floor that players cannot cross.
 2) One person tosses a target duck balloon into the air.
 3) Hunters throw or kick their own balloons without stepping over the line to hit the duck balloon.
 4) The team that hits the target balloon the most times in the allotted time with fewer attempts wins.
Duck-shaped balloons, regular balloons, floor marking tape

1) Form teams in an open and safe space.
 2) Hold hands in a circle, designate a king inside, and place the tagger on the opposite side.
 3) For a set time, the tagger tries to tag the king while teammates rotate while maintaining the circle to protect the king.
 4) The round ends if the king is tagged, teammates lose hands, or someone falls.

1) Divide into teams, set the running order, and place a defender in the opponent's face-off zone.
 2) Run from the starting zone to the face-off zone and play rock-paper-scissors with the defender.
 3) If you lose to the defender, say "Wait!" and run back to the starting line before running back.
 4) If you win, return to the start line and bring 1 teammate along to run together.
 5) Add 1 player each time you win; all members must enter the face-off zone before playing rock-paper-scissors, and the team that brings all members first wins.
4 traffic cones, scoreboard, timer, team pinnies

1) Set the throwing spot and target spot, then line up in single file by team.
 2) Take turns throwing cones to stack them over the base cone.
 3) If you fail, put the cone back, touch the opposite wall, and go to the back of the line; if successful, go directly to the back to try again.
 4) The team that stacks all cones first or stacks more within the time limit wins.
Pass the Balloon to the End

1) Sit on chairs facing each other in two rows and check the passing order.
 2) The first player taps the balloon into the air toward the next player.
 3) Without catching or holding the balloon, players tap it along the line to the last person without letting it hit the floor.
 4) Once reached to the end, challenge sending it all the way back in reverse.
스마트폰(만보기 어플) 또는 만보기, 작은 가방

1) Start a pedometer app on a smartphone and place it into a pocket or pouch.
 2) Move actively in place by running or jumping during the set time to rack up steps.
 3) Shaking the device directly with hands is forbidden; pass the device to the next teammate when time runs out.
 4) The team with the highest total step count wins.
Smartphones with pedometer app, small bags

1) Prepare a set of cone discs in 3-4 colors, marker cones, and a scoreboard.
 2) Hold multiple cone discs together and throw them into the air at once.
 3) Run to catch your assigned team color cone disc and return first to earn points, or win instantly by catching it in midair.
 4) Take turns competing and the team with the higher score wins.

1) Line up at the starting line holding a disc cone.
 2) Toss the cone into the air simultaneously on the starting signal.
 3) Sprint to where the cone landed, pick it up, and prepare to throw it again.
 4) Repeat tossing and chasing around the turning point, scoring or winning in order of returning to the start.
고리던지기용 고리 여러 개, 백업 스틱, 라바콘

1) Face each other holding foam noodles and prepare to pass the ring.
 2) Slide the ring along the floor accurately toward your partner across the space.
 3) Successfully catching the sliding ring with the foam noodle before it stops scores 1 point.
 4) Take turns upon failure or switch pairs, competing to achieve the highest score within the given time.
Toss rings, foam noodles, marker cones

1) Clear classroom desks to create a course and set up starting and turnaround cones.
 2) Move forward while bouncing the shuttlecock upward with the paddle without letting it hit the floor or ceiling.
 3) If the shuttlecock drops or hits the ceiling, complete a penalty mission (e.g., 3 star jumps) before resuming.
 4) Round the turnaround marker and pass the equipment to the next runner in a relay race.

1) Each student prepares a cushion to throw.
 2) Mark the starting line and scoring zones (foul, 1 point, 2 points, 1 point, etc.) on the classroom floor using tape.
 3) Set a throwing order and take turns tossing the cushion from the starting line.
 4) Tally the points based on where the cushion lands across multiple rounds.
라바콘 여러 개, 접시콘, 훌라후프, 점수판, 피구공

1) Divide into teams, set the throwing and catching order, and have two players step forward.
 2) Throw the ball high overhead from a spot and run to the opposite side.
 3) The player on the opposite side runs in and catches the ball before it touches the ground.
 4) Earn 1 point by catching the ball before it drops; the team with the most successful catches within the time or round limit wins.
Several traffic cones, disc cones, hula hoops, scoreboard, dodgeball

1) Divide into teams and line up with feet touching the starting cone at the end of the field stands.
 2) On signal, run along the bleachers toward the disc cones placed on top of the cones at the far end.
 3) The first player to grab a disc cone scores 1 point and runs back to the starting point.
 4) The first player to stack the disc cone onto the starting cone earns 1 point; the team with the highest total score after everyone takes turns wins.

1) Each student folds a paper airplane using an A4 sheet.
 2) Stack 10 cups in a pyramid (4-3-2-1) on a desk as the target.
 3) Teammates take turns throwing paper airplanes toward the cup pyramid from the designated line.
 4) The team earns points equal to the total number of cups knocked down within the given time.
10 Speed Stacks cups, cones, A4 paper
스피드스택스 컵(팀원 수만큼), 탁구공, 바닥 라인 테이프

1) Divide into teams, stand in a circle holding cups, and decide the order of throwing and catching.
 2) The first player bounces a ping-pong ball off the floor toward the next teammate.
 3) When caught with the cup, the team earns 1 point, and that player bounces it to the next teammate.
 4) If missed, the next player restarts the bounce, and total points are tallied after everyone finishes.
Speed Stacks cups, ping-pong balls, floor marking tape

1) Sit on chairs in a circle.
 2) The first player places the ball on their feet or grips it with both feet to prepare.
 3) Pass the ball sequentially onto the next person's feet to complete a full loop.
 4) If the ball drops to the floor, restart from that player and complete the loop.
Roll the Hoop As Far As It Goes

1) Mark the start line and destination line, then roll the hoop forward.
 2) Run to where the hoop rolls and pick it up only after it comes to a complete stop, then roll it again.
 3) The player or team that reaches the destination or circles back to the start line first wins.
 4) Alternatively, players can compete to reach the target with fewer rolling attempts.
Dribble and Place the Ball Relay

1) Divide into teams and get ready at the starting cone with a hand on the cone.
 2) The first runner dribbles the soccer ball with feet, places it inside the hula hoop, and runs back to the start cone.
 3) The next runner sprints to the hoop and dribbles the ball back.
 4) Teams alternate, and the team whose runners return and touch the cone first wins.

1) Set up 5 targets and draw a kicking line at a distance.
 2) Each player kicks a ball 3 times to knock down the targets.
 3) If all 5 targets are knocked down within 3 kicks, re-stack them and use remaining kicks to score more points.
 4) Any targets left standing after 3 kicks become the opponent team's points.

1) Decide whether to participate sitting on a chair or standing.
 2) Players sitting must not rise from their chairs, and standing players are eliminated if they lift either foot.
 3) Teammates take turns keeping the balloon airborne without letting it hit the ground.
 4) The team that keeps the balloon aloft until the time limit wins.
라바콘 10개, 접시콘 5개(대체 시 종이컵 5개, 마스킹 테이프)

1) Place 5 cones on each side and start with 5 dish cones.
 2) Place a dish cone on the left cone, turn around the turning point, and move cones to the right repeatedly.
 3) For a 1-on-1 match, use different colored cones and start from opposite sides to see who finishes first.
 4) If cones are unavailable, paper cups and masking tape can be used as alternatives.
10 cones, 5 dish cones (or 5 paper cups, masking tape)

1) Set up goals on both ends using cones.
 2) Hold a plank position and use your hands to slide marker cones to score and defend.
 3) Score a point whenever the cone passes through the opponent's goal.
 4) Touching your knees to the ground is a foul, and the player with the most points wins.
라바콘, 축구공, 타이머, 백업 스틱, 팀 조끼

1) Divide into teams and determine the dribbling order.
 2) Dribble the soccer ball by kicking it, turn around the turning point, and return to the start line.
 3) Pass the ball accurately to the next runner upon returning and move to the back of the line.
 4) As a variation, pairs hold hands or hold a foam noodle while taking turns kicking the ball around the turning point.
Cones, soccer ball, timer, foam noodles, team pinnies

1) Fold origami paper ddakji tiles with team members within a set time.
 2) Write 'Treasure' on both sides of one ddakji and place it on the floor.
 3) One player from each team steps forward to flip the treasure tile; failed ddakji remain on the floor.
 4) Successfully flipping the treasure tile allows the player to sweep all accumulated tiles, and the team with the most tiles wins.

1) Mark shooting spots in numerical sequence starting from spot 1 using spot markers.
 2) Players take turns shooting at the basketball hoop starting from spot 1.
 3) If a shot misses, move to the end of the line and wait for the next turn.
 4) If the shot goes in, advance to the next spot number, and the player clearing the most spots within the time limit wins.
공 여러 개, 점수판, 매트(요가 매트)

1) Lie down side-by-side on exercise mats, with each player holding a dodgeball or bouncy ball.
 2) Push the ball upward with both hands high toward the ceiling without touching it.
 3) Catch the falling ball while remaining completely flat on the mat to score 1 point.
 4) Dropping the ball or sitting up off the mat results in elimination, and the player with the most catches wins.

1) Gather various classroom items such as brooms, umbrellas, markers, and foam sticks along with a trash bin.
 2) Divide into teams and have one representative from each team step forward.
 3) Play rock-paper-scissors to select a throwing item, then throw it toward the bin from behind the foul line.
 4) Score points for each item successfully landing inside the bin, and the team with the higher score wins.
Trash bin or umbrella stand, various throwing items, scoreboard

1) Two players face each other at the basic distance cones and throw a flying disc.
 2) Upon a successful catch, take one step back to increase the distance.
 3) If a catch fails, step one step forward to try again from a closer distance.
 4) Keep one pivot foot planted without lifting it while throwing.

1) Set up an upright object as a target and prepare a flying disc with a hole in the center.
 2) Throw the flying disc from a distance.
 3) Score 1 point if the disc hits the target.
 4) Score 10 points if the disc rings around the target like a necklace.

1) Four players decide their order and set up 10 targets.
 2) Without crossing the line, the first player throws an object by hand to knock down the targets.
 3) If all targets fall, reset 10 targets; if any remain, the next player continues.
 4) Modify the activity by kicking the object instead of throwing.

1) Place a balloon on a plate in each hand, start from the line, and loop around the turning point.
 2) If a balloon falls to the floor, stop in place, pick it up, perform 5 jumping jacks, and then resume.
 3) Return to the starting line and take turns with the next person in line.

1) Form groups of four with 1 king, 2 bodyguards, and 1 tagger.
 2) The king and bodyguards hold hands in a circle while the tagger attempts to tag the king.
 3) Bodyguards rotate left and right to shield the king from the tagger.
 4) Compete for a set duration; the tagger succeeds if they tag the king within the time limit.
몇 번 만에 공 차서 콘 맞추기
Kicking Ball to Hit Cone in Fewest Shots

1) Divide into teams and set the starting line and target point.
 2) Kick the ball in the order decided within the team.
 3) The next person kicks the ball from the spot where it stopped.
 4) Repeat taking turns until hitting the target cone, and the team reaching it in fewer kicks or first wins.
traffic cones, soccer balls, timer, team vests
Tossing Cone Hat onto Traffic Cones

1) Place 5 traffic cones at regular intervals and stand at both starting lines holding 2 dome cones.
 2) On signal, run and place a foot on the side cone, then toss a dome cone to cap it like a hat.
 3) After capping the side cone, attempt to cap the center traffic cone.
 4) The player who caps the center cone first wins, and if time runs out, decide by rock-paper-scissors.
5 traffic cones, 4 dome cones, team vests
Relay Cup Stacking One by One

1) Divide into teams and decide the running order in front of the desk.
 2) The first runner runs with 1 cup, places it on the desk, and returns.
 3) The next runner carries 1 cup, stacks it on the desk, and returns.
 4) Continue taking turns within the time limit; the team that stacks more cups or higher without toppling wins.
speed stacks cups, desks, scoreboard, timer

1) Stack 12 cups and place one different-colored cup on the top.
 2) Hold one end of a towel with one hand and keep the other hand on the waist.
 3) Flick the towel quickly to hit the target cups with the end of the towel.
 4) Score 1 point per fallen cup and an additional 10 points for knocking down the top cup.
Towel, 12 paper cups, 1 different colored cup

1) Divide into teams and prepare 4-5 flying discs per team.
 2) Take turns throwing flying discs from a designated spot into hula hoops.
 3) The team that completes a line horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins.
 4) As a variation, knock an opponent's disc out of a hoop to claim the spot.
Flying discs (4-5 per team), hula hoops
Knock Down the Cone First! Soccer Dribble Game

1) Place a cone in the center and divide students into two competing teams behind the starting lines.
 2) One player from each team dribbles a soccer ball forward simultaneously.
 3) Dribble within shooting distance and kick the ball toward the cone.
 4) Score 1 point for hitting the cone and 5 points for knocking it down; the team with the higher score wins.
Before the Ball Hits the Floor

1) A designated roller rolls the ball from the starting line at a steady pace.
 2) Other participants rush forward to catch the ball before it rolls away or drops.
 3) From the spot where it is caught, the next player rolls the ball again for another teammate.
 4) Progressively challenge the group by varying the ball's speed and size.
출발점 표식, 반환점 표식, 대형 스태킹 컵 세트(팀당 6개)
Run, Stack, Touch, Pack, and Return Relay

1) Divide into 2 to 4 teams and start with one hand and foot touching the lockers at the starting line.
 2) Run forward and stack six large cups into a 3-tier pyramid at the midway point.
 3) Touch the turning point (such as the blackboard) with your hand.
 4) Collapse and repack the 3-tier cup pyramid into a single stack, and the player who returns to the starting line first wins.
start marker, turning point marker, jumbo stacking cup sets (6 cups per team)

1) Set up a circular court using saucer cones.
 2) Start running in the same direction while jumping rope.
 3) The player who covers more distance within the set time and catches up to the opponent wins.
 4) A player wins immediately if the distance to the opponent becomes within 1 meter even if time remains.
Saucer cones, jump ropes, timer, cones

1) Make scoring zones on the classroom floor using masking tape.
 2) Divide into teams and set the throwing order.
 3) Roll 4 Yut sticks together toward the scoring zones.
 4) Score points based on the zones they land in, and the team with higher points wins.

1) Clear space by moving desks and pair up into teams of two.
 2) Practice rallying the shuttlecock back and forth without letting it touch the ground.
 3) Earn 1 point together each time a successful rally pass is made.
 4) Take turns, and the team with the most points wins.

1) Divide into teams and decide offense and defense order.
 2) Player 1 on defense stacks foam dice into a tower, while player 1 on offense prepares with a ball at a distance.
 3) Offense throws the ball to knock down the tower, retrieves the ball, and chases the defense inside the court to tag them.
 4) The number of players tagged until the defense reassembles the tower and calls "Stop!" becomes the offensive score.
Dodgeball, scoreboard, 6 scatter balls (foam dice), team vests, cones
칠판 과녁(자석, 분필), 점수판, 물, 휴지, 폼주사위, 접시콘

1) Draw a target on the chalkboard using chalk or magnets.
 2) Divide into teams and set the throwing order.
 3) Soak tissue paper in water and throw it at the chalkboard target from a designated line.
 4) Points are awarded only if the tissue sticks to the board for at least 3 seconds, and the team with the higher score wins.
Chalkboard target (chalk, magnets), scoreboard, water, tissue paper, foam die, spot markers

1) Set up a basket on the classroom floor as a goal.
 2) Practice kicking the Jegi individually.
 3) Kick the Jegi as many times as possible and kick it toward the basket on the final hit.
 4) Earn bonus points if the Jegi lands inside the basket, and the team with the most points wins.

1) Set a cleaning area using wet wipes or cleaning cloths.
 2) Four players participate, moving around to clean the designated area using the soles of their feet.
 3) Measure the time taken to wipe the entire designated area.
풍선 지키면서 달려요(개인 기록 도전 및 1:1 풍선 터뜨리기 추격전)
Protect the Balloon and Run (Time Trial & Balloon Stomp Chase)

1) Tie a balloon connected to two rubber bands around the ankle and arrange cones in a circle to form a course.
 2) Start from the mark and run the set number of laps without hitting cones to record the fastest time (penalty time added per cone touched).
 3) Two runners start from opposite sides in the same circular direction to chase the opponent and pop their ankle balloon with their foot.
 4) Avoid touching cone obstacles while protecting your own balloon and attempting to pop the opponent's balloon.
라바콘, 접시콘, 뿅망치(백업 스틱), 팀 조끼

1) Prepare at the starting line, excluding the tagger.
 2) Jump forward the designated number of steps.
 3) Turn around and face the tagger after completing the jumps.
 4) The tagger jumps one fewer step than the designated number.
 5) Players tagged are out and move to the mission area to perform a task.
 6) If untagged, jump back across the starting line to survive.
Traffic cones, disc cones, soft foam bat, team vests

1) Prepare to kick the balloon shuttlecock using only feet.
 2) Each person attempts twice, recording the higher count as their score.
 3) The attempt ends immediately if the balloon touches another surface or falls to the floor.

1) Place the treasure ball in the center and line up by number on both sides.
 2) When a number is called, rush to grab the central treasure and return to the team zone to score 1 point.
 3) If you fail to grab the ball first, tag the opponent carrying the treasure back to score 1 point.
 4) The losing team performs 5 star jumps as a mission before the next round.

1) When the tagger stands up, an empty seat is created, and the people directly next to the empty seat cannot move into it.
 2) The tagger walks toward the empty seat while other players move and sit in it first to defend.
 3) If the tagger successfully sits in the empty seat, the tagger wins and the remaining players perform a penalty.
서로 다른 곳에서 출발하는 추격 달리기

1) Teams position runners at different starting points along a circular track.
 2) On start, runners sprint in the assigned direction chasing opponents ahead.
 3) Touching an opponent in front eliminates them from the round.
 4) If neither is caught, the runner returning to their starting point first wins.

1) Pair up facing each other and practice passing the flying disc.
 2) Take one step back every time you successfully catch the disc.
 3) Take one step forward toward your partner whenever you fail to catch it.
 4) Challenge yourselves to reach the furthest distance within the time limit.
왼쪽 오른쪽 돌아 잡아 콘 빼앗기

1) Pair up facing each other with a cone placed midway between you.
 2) Shift one spot to the left on the "Left" call, and to the right on the "Right" call.
 3) Spin 360 degrees in place when you hear "Spin".
 4) Quickly snatch the cone between you the moment "Grab" is called.

1) Two defenders hold a hula hoop together to surround and protect the leader inside.
 2) The tagger starts from the opposite side and moves quickly left and right to touch the leader.
 3) Defenders rotate and move together holding the hoop to keep the leader from being touched.
 4) The tagger's team wins by tagging the leader, or if the defenders let go of the hoop.

1) Three players from each team step forward and roll the dice simultaneously.
 2) The player with the higher dice roll wins and must jump rope that exact number of times without tripping.
 3) Successfully completing the number scores 1 point, and each additional completed set adds bonus points.
 4) The opposing player keeps rolling the dice for defense until rolling a 6, which immediately stops the jumper's turn.

1) Move the cones from the starting point to the second zone one at a time, running back and forth.
 2) Once all cones in the first zone are moved to the second zone, move them from the second to the third zone.
 3) The activity ends when all cones are carried and stacked in the final fourth zone.

1) Set up paper cups on a desk or floor to create targets.
 2) Toss the zipper bag upward with one hand.
 3) Strike the zipper bag downward with the opposite hand toward the paper cup targets.
 4) In multi-player variations, take turns tossing, spiking, and receiving.
요가 매트, 공 여러 개, 수납 통, 타이머

1) Set up mats, balls, and a storage bin on the floor.
 2) Lie on your back on the mat and clamp a ball between your feet.
 3) Lift your legs overhead using abdominal strength to drop the ball into the bin behind you.
 4) Take turns within the time limit, and the team that transfers the most balls wins.
Yoga mats, balls, storage bin, timer
라바콘 여러 개, 점수판, 접시콘, 팀조끼

1) Place a dish cone on your head and stand ready at the starting line.
 2) Run or walk fast toward the turning point when the signal is given.
 3) If the cone falls, perform 5 star jumps on the spot before continuing.
 4) Turn around the marker and return to the start line; the first one back wins.

1) Pair Balloon Tap: Partners stand on spot markers two steps apart, tap the balloon back and forth, and step back one pace after each success.

 3) Winning advances to the next row; losing sends the runner back to the line while the next teammate departs.
 4) Defeating the leader at the apex scores 1 point, and roles switch after a set time.

1) Divide the class into two groups and line up behind opposite starting lines.
 2) One side walks forward like a bear on hands and feet with knees raised.
 3) The opposite side walks sideways like a crab with pinching claw hands.
 4) Upon reaching the opposite line, switch movements and walk back in turn.

1) Gently stretch the neck forward, backward, left, and right.
 2) Interlock fingers, extend arms, and stretch shoulders and torso.
 3) Bend and arch the waist, then rotate ankles smoothly.
 4) Pull knees to chest and heels to buttocks to stretch legs.

1) Teammates sit in a single file line with legs stretched forward, holding the ankles of the person behind them.
 2) On the team cadence chant, bend knees and pull the hips forward in unison to advance.
 3) The student at the very back steers and turns the team around the turning marker cone.
 4) If the caterpillar chain disconnects along the way, pause in place for 3 seconds before reconnecting and racing back to the start.
다양한 색의 원판(참가자 수 미만), 팀 조끼 또는 모자

1) Place colored spot markers 1m apart (fewer than the number of players) and designate a tagger wearing a vest or cap.
 2) The tagger stands in the center and calls out a color available in the area.
 3) Players must quickly find that color on markers, clothing, or equipment and touch it with part of their body.
 4) Up to two players can share a spot; whoever is tagged within 15 seconds becomes the next tagger.
Various colored spot markers, team vest or cap

1) Stand in place and march in sync with your partner.
 2) Stand back-to-back and twist your torsos in opposite directions to touch hands together.
 3) Face your partner, hold their shoulder with your left hand, and pull your right foot back with your right hand.
 4) Hold each other's shoulders and bend forward counting to ten, followed by back-to-back and seated stretches.

1) Form two teams of 6 players each and take attacking and defending positions.
 2) The batter punches the ball with a fist, steps on first base, and runs back to home plate.
 3) Defenders field the ball and throw it to the final defender stationed at home base.
 4) If the runner returns to home before the final defender catches the ball, the team earns 1 point; teams switch after all players bat.

1) Prepare hoops, foam balls, and team vests, divide into two teams, and take positions.
 2) The team with the ball passes and catches while moving to deliver the ball to their teammate inside the hoop.
 3) The team scores 1 point when the teammate inside the hoop successfully catches the ball.
 4) If the ball drops, goes out of bounds, or is intercepted, possession switches to the opponent; the team with the most points wins.

1) Balance on one hand and feet on the mat while extending both feet straight and stretching the other arm.
 2) Place one hand and opposite knee on the floor while keeping the other hand and foot off the ground.
 3) Balance on one foot with arms spread and one leg lifted back, or balance weight between hands and hips.
 4) Partner balance by sitting foot-to-foot holding hands and straightening legs, or hooking inner arms while standing foot-to-foot.
플로어볼채, 플로어볼공, 바구니, 액션 후프, 원마커, 숫자 원마커, 모둠 조끼
Pushing Balls into Targets with Floorball Sticks

1) Form groups of 4 and prepare floorball sticks and 3 floorball balls at the start line.
 2) Players stand sideways in turn and push the ball toward target hoops.
 3) Score the points designated on each hoop where the ball lands.
 4) The team with the highest combined total score from all members wins.
Floorball sticks, floorball balls, baskets, action hoops, spot markers, numbered markers, team vests

1) Form two teams of four players each, decide which team starts with the ball, and take positions on the field.
 2) The team with the ball uses various kicking and stopping skills to pass the ball to a teammate in the scoring zone.
 3) A point is scored when the teammate standing inside the scoring zone successfully receives and stops the ball.
 4) If the opposing team intercepts the ball or kicks it out of bounds, possession switches, and the team with the highest score within the time limit wins.

1) Slowly rotate the wrists and alternately rotate both ankles.
 2) Stretch your arms upwards and then extend them sideways.
 3) Slowly roll your neck, then slowly rotate your waist.
 4) Hop lightly upwards.

1) Face your partner with a set distance between you.
 2) Decide the direction of rotation, and one person calls out 'one, two, three.'
 3) Turn in the decided direction on the cue and catch the stick released by the partner.
 4) If the stick does not fall, repeat to count successful catches, then expand the activity with the whole class forming a single group.

1) Practice spinning the hula hoop around the waist, wrist, or ankle.
 2) When spinning on the ankle, hop back and forth with the hooped foot while jumping over it with the other foot.
 3) Use wrist snap to throw and roll the hula hoop with backspin.
 4) Hold the hoop with both hands like a jump rope and jump over it with both feet together.
골프형 활동: 공을 정확하게 및 멀리 보내기
스내그 골프채, 나비 골프채, 공, 조끼
Golf Activity: Accurate and Long Distance Shots

1) Grip the golf club with both hands, wrapping the right hand around the left thumb.
 2) Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in parallel and look at the target.
 3) Take a backswing and hit the ball lightly while keeping shoulders and arms in a straight line for accuracy.
 4) Lift the club handle to shoulder height, rotate the hips, and swing through to hit the ball far.
SNAG golf clubs, Nabi golf clubs, balls, vests

1) Stand in a circle, each holding a long wooden stick.
 2) When one person gives the signal 'one, two, three,' everyone releases their stick and quickly moves forward to catch the stick in front of them.
 3) Players who catch the stick before it falls continue playing.
 4) When two players remain, they determine the winner through rock-paper-scissors.

1) Divide into an attacking team and a defending team.
 2) Defenders stand freely inside the court and place a plastic bottle upright beside themselves.
 3) Attackers roll balls from outside the court to knock down the bottles, while defenders catch the balls by hand and send them out.
 4) Switch roles and repeat; the team with the most standing bottles at the end of the time wins.
Walking on the Balance Beam in Various Ways

1) Step onto the balance beam while shifting your weight from the floor and spread both arms for balance.
 2) Touch the side of the beam with your stepping foot to check it and move forward one foot at a time to the end.
 3) Turn sideways, spread both arms, move the front foot forward, and pull the back foot in to walk sideways.
 4) Lower your posture, spread both arms, reach your foot below the beam surface and bring it back up while walking.

1) Sit backward on the mat and push with feet to shift center of gravity backward.
 2) Keep knees close to the face while sitting backward.
 3) Bring knees toward the chest and send legs behind the head when the waist touches the mat.
 4) Spread both legs when the back of the head touches the mat and push the mat firmly with both hands to stand up.
긴 줄, 반환점 라바콘, 팀 조끼

1) Tie both ends of a long rope to make a circular train shape.
 2) The designated engineer steps inside the rope and holds it around waist height.
 3) The engineer drives around picking up passengers one by one, and all passengers hold the rope while moving together.
 4) In a team race, the train that goes around the turning point and returns first wins.
Long rope, Turning cones, Team vests
우리 집 지키기 공 굴리기 게임
Defend Our House Ball Rolling Game

1) Divide students into attacking and defending groups and put on team pinnies.
 2) Defenders stand inside the playing area and set up foam bowling pins next to themselves.
 3) Attackers bend down outside the court to roll foam balls inward to knock down pins, while defenders block balls with hands and roll them out.
 4) Switch roles and repeat the game, with the team protecting the most pins within the allotted time winning.
Foam bowling pins, Foam balls, Team pinnies

1) Divide into two groups of 6; one group holds ropes at different heights to form an entrance and exit.
 2) The other group passes through the ropes one by one from entrance to exit.
 3) A player is eliminated if their body touches a rope.
 4) Teams switch roles, and the team with more successful passes wins.
철봉 등 매달릴 수 있는 시설물

1) Select one tagger, and when the game starts, the tagger chases the monkeys.
 2) Monkeys find safe places to hang and suspend themselves to avoid the tagger.
 3) The tagger cannot tag hanging monkeys, but monkeys must move to another spot before the tagger counts to five.
 4) If the tagger tags an unhung monkey, that monkey becomes the next tagger.

1) Learn the 4 stages: Stage 1 (crawling/scooting on the floor), Stage 2 (sitting on a chair), Stage 3 (walking upright), Stage 4 (standing with one hand raised high).
 2) Everyone starts on the floor, roams the classroom, and plays rock-paper-scissors with peers in the same stage.
 3) The winner evolves to the next stage, while the loser remains in the current stage to play again.
 4) Students who reach Stage 4 gather at the blackboard; once more than half the class arrives, all sing together to finish.
Moving with a Ball on a Racket Relay

1) Form groups, and on the start signal, the first runner in each group moves carrying a ball on a racket.
 2) If the ball is dropped halfway, place it back on the racket and resume.
 3) After rounding the cone and returning to the starting line, pass the ball to the next teammate who starts.
 4) The group whose final runner arrives first wins.
Rackets, balls, triangular cones, team vests

1) Stand sideways facing the throwing direction.
 2) Step the back foot toward the throwing direction while bringing the throwing hand back.
 3) Step forward with the opposite foot, rotate the hips and torso, and extend the throwing arm forward to release the ball.
 4) Measure the shortest straight-line distance from the throw line to where the ball landed using a tape measure.

1) Strike the bamboo sticks twice open and once closed according to a three-beat rhythm.
 2) Jump twice between the sticks and jump landing with both feet apart outside.
 3) Hop one foot at a time alternately between the moving bamboo sticks.
 4) Jump twice between the sticks and turn around to jump landing with both feet apart.

1) Insert thumb, middle, and ring fingers into the mini bowling ball holes.
 2) Relax shoulders and face toward the target pins.
 3) Step forward, push arms forward, and swing the ball back.
 4) Lower posture, shift weight onto one foot, and roll the ball to knock down the pins.
탁구공, 삼각콘, 원마커, 바구니, 모둠 조끼
Catching Table Tennis Balls with Cones

1) Divide the class into two teams, with one catcher from each team standing in the receiving area facing their group.
 2) The first player bounces a table tennis ball on the floor, and the catcher catches it with a cone.
 3) If missed, retry; if successful, the thrower becomes the new catcher and the previous catcher goes to the back of the line.
 4) The team that successfully catches all table tennis balls first wins.
Table tennis balls, cones, spot markers, baskets, team vests

1) The tagger wears a typhoon necklace around their neck to be marked.
 2) The tagger shouts in place, 'One, two, three, four, I am a typhoon!' to start the game.
 3) The typhoon chases other players dodging around, and anyone tagged becomes a 'little typhoon' who stands in place and only swings their arms.
 4) If a player touches a little typhoon's hand, they also become a little typhoon standing in that spot, and the game ends when everyone is tagged.
머리 위로 공 전달하기 릴레이 놀이

1) Form teams of players numbered 1 through 4, standing in a straight line with their backs to the finish line.
 2) On the starting signal, the front player passes the ball backward overhead.
 3) After passing the ball, quickly run to the very end of the line to get ready to receive the ball again.
 4) Keep passing backward, and when the ball crosses the finish line, shout hurrah; the team that finishes first wins.

1) Bend neck forward and backward, then tilt side to side using hands.
 2) Place hands on shoulders and rotate shoulders forward and backward.
 3) Pull palm backwards, and stretch arms across the chest alternately.
 4) Clasp hands overhead to stretch the sides, then sit down to stretch legs and rotate ankles.

1) Line up in rows of four behind the starting line.
 2) At the start signal, identify the animal assigned to the first section and run while mimicking its movement.
 3) When reaching the next section, change the running gait according to the newly designated animal.
 4) Shout 'Finished!' loudly upon reaching the finish line; the next group starts when all four members arrive.
Creative Relay Running Game with Hula Hoops

1) Divide the class into two teams, determine the running order, and line up at the starting line.
 2) On the signal, the first runner runs and passes the hula hoop zone using their own method (spinning, jumping over, etc.), which becomes the team's official rule.
 3) Upon reaching the turning point, pick up the hula hoop from the cone, perform the established hoop rule, place it back on the cone, and run back.
 4) Tag the next runner's hand at the starting line; all subsequent runners repeat the same hoop action, and the first team whose final runner returns wins.

1) The whole class forms a large circle around floor spot markers.
 2) Choose two taggers to enter the center markers.
 3) The two taggers play rock-paper-scissors to assign upper-body and lower-body roles.
 4) When music plays, taggers demonstrate their movements and other students combine and imitate them.

1) Divide into two teams of three, determine the running order, and line up at the starting line.
 2) At the signal, the first runner runs zigzag between cones in zone 1.
 3) In zone 2, hop forward with joined feet, and in zone 3, make an elephant trunk with arms and spin three times in place.
 4) In zone 4, roll three times on the mat, cross the finish line, and send the next runner; the team whose final runner finishes first wins.

1) Four students form a team and line up along a series of hula hoops.
 2) The first runner takes a beanbag from the first hoop and moves it to the second.
 3) Each subsequent teammate takes the beanbag and moves it to the next hoop in order.
 4) The team that successfully transfers all beanbags to the final hoop first wins.
콩주머니, 바구니, 미니허들, 원마커, 모둠 조끼

1) Divide into two teams and set the running order.
 2) At the signal, the first runner wearing a team vest takes a beanbag and jumps over obstacles (mini-hurdles) with both feet together to put it in a basket.
 3) Jump back over the obstacles with both feet together to return.
 4) The next runner starts when the previous runner crosses the start line, and the team whose final runner finishes first wins.
Beanbags, baskets, mini-hurdles, spot markers, team vests

1) Form groups of four, wear team vests, and decide the order of players.
 2) When the opposing group calls out a marker color, step on that spot marker in order and hold balance on both feet.
 3) Once all teammates are positioned, opposing players enter one by one and initiate a palm-push battle.
 4) The group earns 1 point for each player who withstands the push without falling, and the team with the most points wins.

1) Line up at the start line in pairs, and the first pair holds a scarf with a fluff ball placed on it.
 2) On signal, hold the scarf together and walk around the cone and back.
 3) When the previous pair returns, the next pair receives the scarf with the fluff ball and starts.
 4) The team whose final pair finishes first wins.
Cones, fluff balls, scarves, team pinnies

1) Divide students into groups and set up triangular cones numbered 1 through 6 in front of the teams.
 2) Runners from each group take turns rolling a die and checking the rolled number.
 3) The runner sprints to turn around the cone corresponding to the rolled number and runs back.
 4) The group whose members finish running first wins the game.

1) Sit on a towel with knees bent, keeping both hands and feet outside the towel on the floor.
 2) On the start signal, push the floor with hands and feet while simultaneously pulling forward with hips.
 3) Repeat the gliding motion to go around the turning marker and return to the starting line.
 4) Can be played as tournament races or group relay challenges.

1) Place both feet on the take-off board and face forward.
 2) Bend knees to lower posture, swing arms back and forward, then push off powerfully with both feet.
 3) Jump high while raising arms upward and arching the back slightly in mid-air.
 4) Extend arms and legs forward, tuck the body, and bend knees upon landing.
Tape measure, sand rake, take-off board

1) Form two teams of 5 and stand in designated zone positions.
 2) The offensive goalkeeper initiates play by passing to the forward zone, and attackers advance the ball avoiding defenders.
 3) The front attacker shoots on goal while defenders attempt to block the shot.
 4) Scoring in the opposing goal awards 1 point, and turnovers switch offense and defense until the team with more points wins.

1) Runner 2 lowers their posture to start quickly and watches Runner 1 approaching.
 2) Runner 1 approaches without slowing down.
 3) When Runner 1 reaches the agreed mark, Runner 2 sprints forward extending a hand backward, and Runner 1 calls out a signal to pass the baton.
 4) Runner 2 receives the baton and dashes vigorously forward.

1) Set cones 15m apart for forward sprints, or set saucer cones in a 3m zigzag for lateral runs.
 2) On signal, run forward and turn around the opposite cone.
 3) For lateral runs, use side steps from the first cone to touch left and right cones in sequence.
 4) Repeat within one's own capability to build physical endurance.

1) Put on the uniform and take the ready stance.
 2) Perform low block, reverse punch, middle inside block, and return punch in designated order.
 3) Perform high block followed by right front kick and reverse punch, then high block followed by left front kick and reverse punch.
 4) Perform low block and reverse punch, then return to the ready stance.

1) Prepare cones and an agility ladder.
 2) Perform rapid burpee get-ups and quickly mirror a partner's movements.
 3) Run zig-zag through cones or run to touch 5 cones placed in a star pattern.
 4) Move laterally stepping one foot per ladder rung or jump forward alternating feet apart and together.

1) Interlock fingers and rotate wrists while rolling each ankle sequentially to the count.
 2) Place hands on waist and rotate head and hips in 4-count turns left and right.
 3) Stretch arms across the chest or pull foot backwards to stretch legs while holding for 10 counts.
 4) Interlock fingers, reach forward, and hold the full-body stretch.

1) Place both hands firmly on the mat.
 2) Kick legs upward and rotate sideways.
 3) Land while maintaining body balance.

1) Form two teams of four students each, arrange eight desks in two rows of four, and place three beanbags on the first desk.
 2) The first runner performs a push-up against the desk and moves the three beanbags to the next desk in that position, repeating until the last desk.
 3) The next runner starts from the opposite side and moves the beanbags in the same manner.
 4) The team whose final runner finishes moving all the beanbags first wins.
8 desks, 3 beanbags, spot markers, team vests
줄과 천을 활용한 기본 표현 동작
Basic Expression Movements Using Ropes and Cloth

1) Hold the rope with both hands, swing it, and jump over it with one or both feet.
 2) Hook one toe onto the rope, extend the leg straight up, and balance.
 3) Hold the rope with both hands and swing one arm to wrap the rope.
 4) Hold the cloth with one or both hands, wave, spin, or throw and catch it above the head.

1) Underhand serve: Place the ball on the palm with feet staggered, bring the other fist forward to strike the ball.
 2) Overhead set: Place both hands above the head forming a triangle with fingers, bend and extend knees, pushing the ball with wrists and fingers.
 3) Spike: Approach, jump, swing arm upward to hit the ball with the open palm, and snap the wrist downward.
 4) Block: Jump near the net with arms extended to block the ball, angling hands slightly forward.
Volleyball, net, net posts, scrimmage vests

1) Extend arms and legs, exhaling through the nose underwater.
 2) Circle arms outward to pull water, and inhale through the mouth as the head surfaces.
 3) Bend elbows to bring hands in front of the chest, draw heels in, and turn ankles outward.
 4) Extend arms forward, push water backward using ankles, bring legs together, and glide in a straight body line.

1) Form a group of 5 players and choose 2 players to hold the elastic cord.
 2) Other players call out the target height and take turns cartwheeling over the elastic cord.
 3) Earn 1 point for clearing ankle height, 2 points for knee height, and 3 points for waist height.
 4) The group with the highest score after the set number of attempts wins.
큰 공, 타원형 공, 작은 공

1) Stagger feet forward and backward, pushing and rolling a large ball with both hands.
 2) Kneel on one knee and roll an oval-shaped ball along the floor with both hands.
 3) Stagger feet, bend at the waist, and roll a small ball with one hand.
large ball, oval ball, small ball
접시콘, 줄넘기, 미니 허들, 티볼 공

1) Jump with both feet together jumping side to side over dish cones.
 2) Jump with both feet together while quickly swinging the jump rope twice for double unders.
 3) Bend knees into a squat and jump up explosively.
 4) Jump over obstacles with both feet together and throw a tee-ball ball quickly with one hand.
Dish cones, Jump rope, Mini hurdles, Tee-ball

1) Raise one knee and extend the foot straight ahead to kick forward.
 2) Raise one knee, turn your gaze backward, and kick behind you.
 3) Stand facing forward, turn 90 degrees to the right, and kick using the outer edge of your foot.
 4) Stand facing forward, turn 90 degrees to the left, and kick using the outer edge of your foot.
통통볼, 삼각콘, 킥보드, 안전모, 팔꿈치 보호대, 무릎 보호대

1) Ride the bouncing ball by kicking the floor and moving straight ahead while bouncing up.
 2) Ride the bouncing ball by kicking the floor with both feet, alternating left and right to move in curves.
 3) Place one foot on the center of the kickboard deck and push against the ground to move in a straight line.
 4) Place one foot on the center of the kickboard deck and steer with the handlebars to move in curves.
Bouncing ball, cones, kickboard, helmet, elbow pads, knee pads

1) Form two teams of 5 players each, and pairs of players take their assigned positions.
 2) The team with the ball passes it with their feet toward a teammate in the scoring zone using various methods.
 3) If the teammate in the scoring zone receives the ball, the team earns 1 point.
 4) If the opposing team intercepts the ball, possession switches, and the team with the most points within the set time wins.

1) For backhand throwing, pull the disc to chest height and release horizontally by extending the arm and wrist.
 2) For forehand throwing, raise the disc vertically at shoulder height and release horizontally extending arm and wrist.
 3) For pancake catching, reach toward the incoming disc, pull toward the body, and clamp hands together like clapping.
 4) For two-handed rim catching, extend both hands toward the disc, pull toward the body, and grip the rim.

1) Stand properly in front of the mat in ready position for a backward roll.
 2) Place both hands by the mat and tuck your chin toward your chest.
 3) Push the floor firmly with both feet and roll backward keeping the body rounded.
 4) Stand up and regain balance to finish the roll.

1) Hold the ball with both hands above your head to throw forward, and catch balls arriving overhead.
 2) Throw at chest height by extending arms, and catch incoming chest-level balls by pulling toward the chest.
 3) Hold the ball with one hand and throw upward from below waist level.
 4) Lower your stance and catch the falling ball using your palms and fingers.

1) Form two teams of 6 players wearing team vests and stand in designated positions.
 2) Start play with a serve upon the signal, allowing one bounce on the floor, and hit the ball back over the net within three touches.
 3) Score 1 point when the opposing team fails to receive the ball or cannot return it over the net.
 4) The team with more points scored during the set time limit wins.
Big volleyball, net, posts, team vests

1) Pair up in twos and throw and catch a soft ball while singing a song.
 2) When the song ends, the player holding the ball becomes the tagger and chases their partner.
 3) If caught, that player becomes the new tagger, performs 3 jumping jacks, and chases the partner.
 4) When the signal sounds, gather again to start the next round.

1) Run with an upright torso and good running form.
 2) If out of breath or fatigued, switch to walking to regulate breathing.

1) Run with relaxed shoulders and minimal upper body movement.
 2) Take shorter strides so that the entire sole of the foot touches the ground lightly.
 3) When feeling breathless or tired while running, walk with an upright back, look forward, regulate breathing, and maintain proper posture.
 4) Resume running once your breathing becomes comfortable.
배팅 티, 티볼 공, 티볼 배트, 글러브, 누

1) Divide into batting and fielding teams of 6 players each and stand at assigned positions.
 2) After hitting, the batter runs around 1st and 2nd base and returns home to score 1 point.
 3) A batter is out if they miss three swings, hit a fly ball that is caught, or if the ball reaches base before the runner.
 4) Switch sides after 3 outs, play 4 innings, and the team with the most points wins.
Batting tee, tee-ball, tee-ball bat, gloves, bases

1) Practice forward hopping on one foot and jumping forward off both feet.
 2) Jump sideways over spot cones with both feet by bending and extending knees.
 3) Jump upward on the spot while opening and closing legs, or jumping high stretching both arms.
 4) Place both hands on the floor in a squat position and spring forward extending knees.

1) Divide into 4 teams of 3 players each, stationed in four court zones divided by crossed nets.

 4) Score a point when an opposing team fails to return the ball; the team with the highest score at the end wins.
Jokgu ball, net, posts, team vests

1) Dribbling with hands: Bounce the ball on the floor using the arm and wrist while moving.
 2) Dribbling with feet: Slowly guide the ball along using the inside of the foot while moving.
 3) Dribbling with a stick: Keep the ball in the center of the body and guide it using both the inside and outside faces of the stick.

1) Divide into groups of three for offense and defense.
 2) On the signal, attackers start from the line, pass and dribble, and score 1 point per basket.
 3) Attackers cannot take more than two steps while holding the ball.
 4) When out of bounds, the opposing team restarts from that spot; the team with the most points when time expires wins.
플로어볼 채, 플로어볼 공, 플라스틱 통 2개, 모둠 조끼

1) Divide into two teams and take positions on the court.
 2) On the signal, hit the ball with the floorball stick to start the game.
 3) If an attacker pushes or holds a defender, roles switch; if a defender fouls, play restarts from that spot.
 4) Hit the opponent's plastic bin to score 1 point, and the team with the most points when time expires wins.
Floorball sticks, floorball balls, 2 plastic bins, team vests
풍선 신체 부위 튕기기 및 풍선 배구
Balloon Body Bouncing and Balloon Volleyball

1) Inflate a balloon to a suitable size and tie it off.
 2) Bounce the balloon above head level for 1 minute each using hands, feet, head, knees, and volleyball set posture while counting reps.
 3) Compete to see who can bounce the balloon overhead the most without lifting their feet off the ground.
 4) Play balloon volleyball in pairs using hands or feet.

1) Clap 3, 5, and 10 times, then clench and open fists 3, 5, and 10 times.
 2) Interlock fingers and rotate wrists in both directions for 8 counts each.
 3) Make an elephant-trunk arm lock and pull while turning your head, then pull your elbow behind your head.
 4) Stretch interlocked hands forward, upward, and sideways, stretch the neck in all directions, and pat the shoulders and arms.

1) Spread numbered spot markers across the floor and determine turn order.
 2) Stand at spot marker 1 and toss the beanbag toward spot marker 2.
 3) If the beanbag misses, the next player takes a turn; on the next turn, throw again from where the beanbag landed.
 4) Successfully landing on a spot allows an immediate throw toward the next numbered hole until reaching hole 10.

1) Spread dish cones across the play area with roughly equal numbers facing upright and upside down.
 2) Divide into two teams, assigning one team to flip cones upright and the other team upside down.
 3) On the signal, players race to flip cones to their assigned orientation within the time limit.
 4) When time is called, count the cones; the team with the most cones facing their orientation wins.
바운다룬, 공, 풍선, 탱탱볼, 솜털 공, 훌라후프

1) Balance a ball horizontally on the bounda-loon without dropping it while navigating obstacles.
 2) Bounce and volley a balloon or bouncy ball into the air or off the ground.
 3) Strike a tossed fleece ball using the bounda-loon into a hula hoop target.
 4) Rally a balloon back and forth in pairs to see who maintains the longest rally.
